jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
The Product Manager owns the Mizzen ON ecommerce product across all storefronts and markets, and is accountable for the roadmap, the product and IT budget, and the delivery of every platform change from business case to go-live. The role leads the strategic projects that move the business forward, including the 180 headless project for Kuwait, payments for Kuwait and KSA, Bloomreach search and Premise returns, and more projects to come into the future (APP development, etc) and working hand in hand with IT, Finance and Procurement. It negotiates with web agencies and technology vendors to secure the right scope at the right rate, and holds them to plan. The role leads and develops the Assistant Product Manager, sets the pace and standard for the team, and is the senior product contact for leadership, the global Mizzen ON brand and the Digital Operations vertical.

**Key Accountabilities**

**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Owns the product vision and the 12-month roadmap for the On ecommerce platform, prioritised on customer value, revenue impact, cost and effort.
* Builds the business case for each major initiative, including expected benefit, cost, timeline and success measures, and secures sign-off from the Head of Ecommerce.
* Reviews performance data and customer feedback to decide what to build, improve or stop, and re-prioritises when the business need changes.
* Aligns the roadmap with the global Mizzen ON brand on feature parity, standards and shared technology.
* Tracks competitor and market trends in premium and sportswear ecommerce, and brings forward ideas that keep the On platform ahead.
* Presents the roadmap and quarterly priorities to the Head of Ecommerce and wider leadership.

**Budget & IT Planning**

* Builds the annual product and IT budget, covering agency retainers, development work, platform and app licences, integrations and third-party tools.
* Forecasts and tracks spend monthly against budget with Finance, explains variances and reallocates within approved limits.
* Partners with IT on capacity, architecture and investment planning, so the roadmap is resourced and technically sound.
* Manages the Shopify platform commercially, including plan, app and integration costs, and the total cost of ownership of the stack.

**Agency, Vendor & Commercial Management**

* Negotiates rates, scopes, retainers and contract terms with web agencies and technology vendors, with Procurement, to secure better value without lowering delivery quality.
* Runs vendor selection and requests for proposal, compares options on cost, capability and risk, and recommends a preferred partner.
* Holds agencies and vendors to agreed service levels and delivery commitments, and reviews their performance against contract.
* Manages the relationship with Shopify, app and integration partners together with Procurement and IT.

**Project Planning & Delivery**

* Leads delivery of strategic projects end to end with IT, owning the project plan, budget, risks, dependencies and go-live decision.
* Builds and maintains detailed project plans and Gantt charts covering milestones, dependencies, owners and critical path, and keeps them current as plans change.
* Runs a disciplined follow-up rhythm, including status meetings, action logs, RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) and written updates, so every action has an owner and a date.

**Strategic Projects**

* 180 Project: leads the headless storefront build for Kuwait, delivered with IT.
* Payments for Kuwait and KSA: new payment methods and providers for both markets, including CCOD for KSA first, then assessment for other markets.
* Bloomreach for search: implementation of Bloomreach to improve site search and product discovery.
* Premise for returns: implementation of the Premise returns platform, delivered with Digital Operations.
* Gift card functionality: exploration, business case and recommended approach for gift cards across markets.

**Agile Delivery & Platform Ownership**

* Sets sprint goals and priorities for the product backlog, and oversees sprint planning, grooming, reviews and retrospectives run by the Assistant Product Manager with the web agency.
* Owns the Shopify platform direction, including apps, integrations, checkout and headless architecture decisions, together with IT.
* Sets the quality standard for releases, including user acceptance testing, sign-off and rollback plans.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Manages senior stakeholders in IT, Finance and Procurement on budgets, contracts, architecture and project delivery.
* Works with Digital Operations, Customer Service, Marketing, Merchandising, Logistics and Retail to understand needs and agree priorities.
* Is the senior product contact for the global On brand team and external agencies, representing the On ecommerce product with confidence.
* Influences and negotiates to resolve conflicting priorities, and builds strong, trusted working relationships across the business.
* Reports project status, budget and risks to the Head of Ecommerce and project steering groups, and escalates early with a recommended solution.

**Performance & Governance**

* Defines success measures for each initiative, such as conversion, search usage, payment success rate, return rate and site speed, and reports results after launch.
* Owns product documentation, including requirements documents, release notes and decision logs, and ensures changes follow IT security, data protection and change-control standards.
* Team Leadership & Development
* Leads, motivates and develops the Assistant Product Manager, setting clear objectives, reviewing work and giving regular feedback.
* Coaches the Assistant Product Manager on planning, delivery, stakeholder management and communication, and runs their performance reviews and development plan.
* Sets a high-energy, accountable culture in the product team, and leads by example in pace, quality and ownership.

**Partnership with Digital Operations**

* Works with the Digital Operations Lead on platform changes that affect orders, returns, payments and stock.
* Aligns the Premise returns and new payment rollouts with Digital Operations so processes, SOPs and teams are ready before go-live.
* Agrees release timing with Digital Operations and Customer Service so trading and customers are not disrupted.

**Qualifications And Experience**

* Essential: Bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business or a related field. A project management or agile certification (for example PMP, PRINCE2, Certified Scrum Product Owner or SAFe) is an advantage.
* Essential: minimum 6 years in ecommerce product management or digital project management, including at least 2 years in a senior or lead role.
* Essential: experience managing and developing at least one direct report.
* Demonstrated experience building and managing product or IT budgets, negotiating with agencies and technology vendors, and delivering large multi-stakeholder technology projects such as headless builds, payment integrations or search.
* Experience on Shopify or Shopify Plus. Multi-market GCC experience required. Premium, luxury or sportswear brand preferred.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, MENA CX Improvements, Amazon Customer Service
jobs.description:
**Description**
Amazon Customer Service (CS) is a large and global organization, obsessed with taking care of our customers and delivering reliably fast, convenient, and helpful support when they need it. Whether customers interact with our self-serve solutions or CS Associates, we work hard to make sure they have a delightful experience with us, each and every time.
  
  
We are looking for an experienced customer-obsessed product leader to join us in the MENA Customer Experience Improvement org within Customer Service. You will be a part of the MENA team of product managers, program managers and business analysts who dig deep into customer friction, trace it back to its source, and drive upstream and downstream product and programmatic improvements to improve CX. You and your team will own the roadmap of MENA CX strategic initiatives while also responding to emerging issues that need immediate attention.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
The role requires someone who can use significant expertise and high judgment to distill diverse inputs from large customer segments and stakeholders to set a vision and design the right long-term solutions. You will spend your time analyzing customer friction data to identify the biggest opportunities and building compelling cases for improvements. This means diving deep into significantly complex problems where defects create friction across multiple parts of the customer journey. You will work across multiple organizations and leadership to influence and achieve consensus on priorities.
  
  
You will partner on product and technology solutions within and outside the Amazon Customer Service org to drive high impact innovation and improvements that can transform the service experience we offer to our customers.
  
  
You will create mechanisms that make defect elimination sustainable. This includes building dashboards and tools that show customer impact, designing processes that catch problems before they reach customers, and establishing metrics that keep everyone focused on goals. You will be regularly working at both tactical and strategic levels to deliver results.
  
  
**This Is The Right Role For You If**
You can handle significantly complex problems and efforts, with the ability to see both visible and not-yet-visible risks.
  
  
You excel at taking complex technical problems and explaining them clearly to drive consensus among stakeholders.
  
  
You can work strategically to determine where resources are best applied while actively working to remove bottlenecks.
  
  
You create scalable mechanisms and best practices while effectively influencing and force multiplying across organizations.
  
  
You have deep customer obsession and can translate that into measurable improvements in customer experience.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  
Lead customer experience workstreams by proactively identifying and eliminating sources of friction.
  
  
Create scalable mechanisms to work across cross-functional teams and drive organizational change.
  
  
Establish data-driven approaches to detect issues, surface customer pain points and drive upstream action across organizations.
  
  
Understand how AI is reshaping CX product architectures, product development and customer workflows; apply AI to enable faster learning cycles, accelerate development, make better decisions and unlock new forms of innovation
  
  
Influence strategic direction, customer adoption decisions, engineering and business approach (internally and externally if applicable), vendors, partners, and organization priorities.
  
  
Influence senior leaders to prioritize and address systemic customer experience issues through high-quality analytics and communication.
  
  
Advocate for customers in product, design, and operational decisions across organizations.
  
  
Deliver measurable outcomes aligned with organizational goals.
  
  
Write and present clear narratives to drive alignment and decision-making.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager - Madinat Jumeirah Resort Functions
jobs.description:
**About Jumeirah**

Jumeirah, a global leader in luxury hospitality and a member of Dubai Holding, operates an exceptional portfolio of 29 properties across 11 countries in the Middle East, Europe, and Asia. In 1999, Jumeirah changed the face of luxury hospitality with the opening of the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab and the brand is now renowned worldwide for its distinguished beachfront resorts, esteemed city hotels and exclusive residences. From the contemporary Maldivian island paradise at Jumeirah Olhahali Island to the art-inspired Jumeirah Capri Palace in Italy and the modern twist on a British classic at Jumeirah Carlton Tower in London, the brand has become synonymous with warm and generous service and the ability to craft distinctive and purposeful experiences that bring joy to guests from across the world.

**About Madinat Jumeirah:**

Set along a two-kilometre stretch of private coastline, Madinat Jumeirah is a beachfront resort comprising four distinctive hotels. Each offers uninterrupted views of the Arabian Gulf and the iconic Jumeirah Burj Al Arab, with experiences ranging from the contemporary elegance of Jumeirah Al Naseem to the majestic Arabesque charm of Jumeirah Al Qasr. Guests can also enjoy the serene waterfront setting of Jumeirah Mina Al Salam and the secluded Arabian houses of Jumeirah Dar Al Masyaf. Together, they form a one-of-a-kind destination rooted in Arabian luxury hospitality. The resort features over 20 curated restaurants and lounges, the traditional Souk Madinat Jumeirah, dedicated kids’ clubs and some of the region’s most versatile event and conference spaces.

**About the Job**

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a
**Marketing Manager**
to join
**Madinat Jumeirah Resorts**

The main duties and responsibilities of this role include:

* Provide comprehensive support to the Director of Sales and Marketing (DOSM) in daily marketing activities and campaigns.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned tasks according to predetermined deadlines.
* Assist in managing quotes and obtaining approvals from various suppliers.
* Execute, manage, and adapt marketing plans as necessary.
* Maintain an updated CRM system with all marketing campaigns and projects.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to develop and implement integrated marketing campaigns and activity plans.

**About You**

The ideal candidate for this position will have the following experience and qualifications:

* Bachelor’s degree in marketing, Advertising, Media, or a related field.
* 6-8 years of marketing experience with luxury or hospitality brands.
* Comfortable working under pressure in a fast-paced hospitality environment while maintaining accuracy, tone and brand consistency.

**About the Benefits**

At Jumeirah, we are dedicated to fostering a workplace where colleagues feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow. Our benefits package reflects this commitment by combining rewarding financial incentives, comprehensive healthcare, and opportunities for professional development.

Benefits include:

* Supportive and inclusive work environment
* Access to Learning & Development programmes and clear career pathways
* Opportunities for internal mobility within our global network
* Colleague discounts on food, beverage, and hotel stays worldwide
* Comprehensive healthcare and life insurance coverage
* Paid annual leave entitlement
* Incentive programmes aligned with leadership performance
* Competitive tax-free salary paid in UAE Dirhams (AED)

**Position Overview**

we are committed to building a sustainable and locally rooted food ecosystem. The Marketing Manager will lead the planning, development, and execution of the company’s overall marketing strategy, covering brand development, product marketing, digital marketing, events, campaigns, community engagement, partnerships, and customer experience.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of food, organic and healthy lifestyle products, wellness trends, retail/F&B marketing, events, and community engagement, combined with strong strategic, creative, and analytical capabilities.

* Develop and execute the annual marketing strategy aligned with the company’s vision and business growth objectives.
* Work with the Brand Director/Management on brand positioning, target audiences, and competitive differentiation.
* Develop annual and monthly marketing calendars.
* Establish measurable KPIs for brand awareness, customer engagement, lead generation, footfall, sales, and revenue growth.
* Monitor food, health, wellness, retail, and consumer trends and translate insights into marketing initiatives.
* Conduct competitor and market analysis.

* Plan and execute integrated marketing campaigns across digital, social media, events, retail, and other channels.

* Protect and strengthen the company’s brand reputation.

**4. Product Marketing**

* Develop product positioning, customer messaging, promotional strategies, and launch campaigns.
* Monitor product performance and customer response.
* Support seasonal products, promotions, bundles, and limited time offers.
* Coordinate product photography, menu presentation, packaging, and promotional content.

* Manage the company’s digital marketing strategy across relevant online channels.

* Manage paid digital campaigns and monitor advertising performance.
* Oversee SEO, website content, email marketing, and digital customer engagement.
* Coordinate photography, videography, reels, and other creative content.

* Develop marketing plans for the company Market seasons, events, activations, workshops, and community programs.
* Coordinate pre-event, live-event, and post-event marketing activities.
* Promote vendor participation, customer attendance, workshops, food experiences, gardening activities, and family/community programs.
* Coordinate signage, event branding, promotional materials, digital promotion, and customer communication.
* Work closely with Operations and Events teams to improve visitor experience and market visibility.

**7. Community Engagement & Partnerships**

* Build relationships with local communities, schools, organizations, wellness partners, suppliers, and other stakeholders.
* Identify suitable strategic partnerships and collaboration opportunities.
* Develop community engagement campaigns aligned with the company’s sustainability and healthy-lifestyle positioning.
* Coordinate influencer, media, PR, and partnership activities.
* Support corporate and institutional collaborations.

**8. Customer Experience & Market Research**

* Monitor customer feedback, reviews, surveys, and engagement.
* Identify opportunities to improve the overall customer journey and experience.
* Analyse customer behaviour, preferences, purchasing patterns, and market trends.
* Work with Operations and Product teams to implement customer-focused improvements.
* Develop customer retention and loyalty initiatives.

**9. Content & Creative Management**

* Lead the development of marketing content, campaign concepts, advertisements, menus, brochures, posters, signage, digital assets, and presentations.
* Prepare clear creative briefs for designers, photographers, and agencies.
* Maintain a structured library of approved marketing assets.
* Ensure content quality, accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery.

**10. Sales & Revenue Support**

* Develop marketing initiatives that support sales and revenue objectives.
* Analyze sales performance before, during, and after marketing campaigns.
* Coordinate promotional offers with Finance and Operations to ensure commercial viability.
* Support online delivery and third-party platform promotions.
* Identify opportunities to increase customer traffic, average transaction value, repeat purchases, and product awareness.

**11. Team Management**

* Lead and supervise the Marketing Team.
* Set individual objectives, KPIs, priorities, and deadlines.
* Conduct regular team meetings and performance follow-ups.
* Ensure effective allocation of campaigns and marketing projects.
* Coach and develop team members while maintaining accountability for deliverables.

**12. Reporting & Performance Analysis**

* Prepare weekly and monthly marketing reports for Management.
* Track campaign performance against established KPIs.
* Report on social media performance, customer engagement, website traffic, event performance, marketing expenditure, and campaign ROI.
* Present recommendations based on data and customer insights.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, Digital Marketing, or a related field.

* Minimum 2–3 years of experience managing a marketing team or function preferred.
* Strong experience in digital marketing, social media, events, content, and campaign management.
* Experience in product marketing and new product launches.
* Experience managing marketing budgets and external agencies.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills; Arabic would be an advantage.

Pay: QAR7,000.00 - QAR9,000.00 per month

jobs.title: Brand Equity Analyst
jobs.description:
**Role Description**

The Brand Equity Analyst role at Grupo Montekali is a full-time, hybrid position based in Capital Governorate, Bahrain, with flexibility for some work-from-home days. The role focuses on analyzing brand performance, market trends, and equity drivers to support strategic decisions and investments related to the company’s brand portfolio. Day-to-day responsibilities include gathering and interpreting quantitative and qualitative data, building financial and valuation models to assess brand equity, and preparing reports and dashboards that translate complex insights into clear recommendations for leadership. The Brand Equity Analyst collaborates with marketing, finance, and strategy teams to align brand positioning with financial objectives, monitor competitor activity, and evaluate the impact of campaigns and initiatives on brand value. The role also involves participating in cross-functional projects, presenting findings to stakeholders, and continuously improving analytical frameworks and methodologies.

**Qualifications**

* Strong analytical skills, including the ability to interpret complex data sets, identify trends, and generate actionable insights.
* Knowledge of finance and investments, with exposure to equities and an understanding of how brand equity impacts financial performance.
* Experience with financial modeling, particularly in evaluating brand value, forecasting, and scenario analysis.
* Proficiency with data analysis tools and spreadsheets (e.g., Excel, BI tools), and comfort working with large data sets.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Marketing, or a related field; advanced degree or professional certification (e.g., CFA, CIMA) is an advantage.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to create clear reports, presentations, and visualizations tailored to different stakeholders.
* Collaborative mindset, with experience working in cross-functional teams and managing multiple projects and deadlines.
* Attention to detail, high level of integrity, and commitment to data accuracy and confidentiality.
* Prior experience in brand analytics, equity research, marketing analytics, or corporate finance is beneficial.

**About The Company**
Abdul Latif Jameel Enterprises is part of a diverse business group focused on delivering services that respond to changing customer and market needs. Through AutoHub, the company provides automotive services across collision repair, maintenance, car care, customization, vehicle conversion and electric vehicle services. AutoHub serves customers through a national network, bringing together specialist teams, operational expertise and partner relationships. Its marketing function supports the business by building awareness, strengthening customer relationships and connecting service offerings with the needs of vehicle owners and partners. The company works across a broad ecosystem that includes sister companies, original equipment manufacturers, insurers and technology providers.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Marketing Manager will develop and deliver AutoHub’s annual marketing plan, aligning brand activity with business strategy and commercial priorities. This role leads brand positioning and integrated campaigns across AutoHub’s service portfolio, while overseeing the website, social media channels, marketing budget, agency relationships and campaign performance. The successful candidate will bring together strategic thinking and hands-on execution, translating customer, market and automotive trends into relevant propositions and measurable marketing initiatives.
  
  
Working closely with internal teams and external partners, the Marketing Manager will support demand generation, partnership activation and corporate reputation. The role also involves using customer, digital and campaign data to improve marketing effectiveness and return on investment. A strong interest in emerging technologies is important, including the thoughtful use of generative AI tools to develop copy, images and video content. The position suits a commercially minded marketer who can manage multiple projects, communicate clearly with varied stakeholders and maintain high standards of accuracy and brand consistency.
  
  
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Business Administration or a related field.
* Two to three years of relevant marketing experience; experience in automotive, retail, services, hospitality or another multi-location consumer business is preferred.
* Knowledge of marketing strategy, brand management, integrated campaigns, digital marketing, content, public relations, events, partnerships, agency management, budgeting and performance analytics.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in both Arabic and English.
* Demonstrated ability in strategic planning, campaign and project management, commercial analysis, digital marketing, presentation and creative evaluation.
* Experience managing stakeholders, agencies, suppliers and budgets, with sound negotiation and organizational skills.
* Digital fluency, including the ability to interpret customer, website and campaign data and use insights to improve marketing decisions.

**Responsibilities**

* Develop and deliver the annual marketing plan in line with AutoHub’s strategy, priorities and commercial objectives.
* Lead brand positioning and integrated campaigns for collision repair, maintenance, car care, customization, vehicle conversion and EV services.
* Manage the marketing budget, agencies, suppliers and campaign performance across the national network.

* Oversee social media planning, publishing, community engagement and performance improvement.

* Identify customer, market and automotive trends, developing relevant campaigns, content, lead-generation approaches and local center activations.
* Use data to improve targeting, creative effectiveness and return on investment, while strengthening marketing processes, agency governance and reporting.

**Benefits**
Employees can contribute to a varied automotive services portfolio and work with colleagues and partners across a broad business network. The role offers opportunities to develop strategic and practical marketing capabilities, gain exposure to multiple service categories, and apply digital and AI-enabled approaches to customer-focused campaigns. jobs.title: R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are:**
At Huda Beauty, our Vision is to lead in creating a democratized beauty industry where power is given back to people to define, create, and enjoy beauty for themselves! Launched by award-winning beauty powerhouse Huda Kattan in 2013, Huda Beauty is one of the world's fastest growing beauty brands. As a company, we are fueled by purpose and not profit, this allows us to approach things differently so that we can create products, content, and a community like no other. A lot has changed since our launch in 2013, but something that will forever remain at the core of Huda Beauty is our focus on business excellence and our unwavering passion for kindness!
  
  
**Summary:**
The R&D and Innovation Packaging Manager builds and leads a new pre-development and innovation capability within Product Operations. This role develops, pilots and proves packs, platforms and technologies before the brief, for launches two to three years ahead, so launch teams start from proven solutions instead of discovering risks late. It turns technical scouting, regulatory change such as the EU PPWR, and recurring quality issues into tested, ready-to-use solutions handed over to Packaging Development.
  
  
**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**
:
  
  
**R&D Strategy & Portfolio**

* Build the packaging R&D roadmap for Y+2 and Y+3 launches from the Brand roadmap, consumer and retailer feedback, quality issues, COPQ and technical scouting.
* Select topics that help launches, fix what customers feel, make us different and can be ready in time.
* Manage the R&D portfolio, budget and timelines; stop topics that no longer create value.

**Platforms & Technology**

* Pre-develop functionally proven platforms in key categories (e.g., closures, applicators, mascara, gloss, compacts, pumps, airless).
* Run pilot molds, functional and compatibility tests on our formulas, then homologate with Quality.
* Prove supplier standard packs on our formulas before they are used in launches.
* Build and maintain the Packs Library: proven platforms and standards, with design rules and test files.

**Advanced Development & Innovation**

* Scout new materials, mechanisms, suppliers and manufacturing technologies in line with the roadmap.
* Take ideas to feasible concepts and prototypes, with early risk assessment and filling and assembly implications.
* Assess supplier technical and innovation capability; Procurement leads commercial terms.
* Document new technologies and flag intellectual property opportunities to Legal.

**PPWR & Sustainable Design**

* Translate PPWR design requirements (recyclability, recycled content, minimisation) into design rules, materials and platforms, with Regulatory owning the interpretation.
* Qualify recyclable, mono-material and recycled-content solutions on our formulas, for function and compatibility.
* Build PPWR-ready options into the Packs Library and the materials library for Y+2 and Y+3 launches.
* Track delegated and implementing acts with Regulatory, and update standards when they change.
* Provide technical evidence for conformity documentation; conformity sign-off for each launch sits outside R&D.

**Kaizen & Product Performance**

* Use complaints, reviews, quality trends and COPQ to target issues that repeat across products.
* Develop and test permanent improvements in application, dosing, closing, comfort and robustness.
* Turn each proven fix into updated specifications, design rules and standards

**Handover & Governance**

* Define readiness criteria for handover to Packaging Development: function proven, compatibility tested, homologated and documented.
* Hand over only proven solutions, and support the first launches that use them.
* Use our specification tool and the risk score at R&D stage, in proportion to novelty.
* Protect R&D capacity: support live launches through agreed handovers only, and escalate any trade-off to the Director.

**Leadership and Coaching**

* Build, lead and develop a small R&D team of packaging engineers and technical design support.
* Manage external partners: designers, prototyping houses, test labs and technology partners.
* Build a culture of curiosity, rigor and evidence.

**Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Exposure**

* Partner with Product Development, Marketing, Design, Quality, Packaging Development, Procurement and Regulatory.
* Present the R&D pipeline, business cases and recommendations to leadership.
* Build long-term technical partnerships with innovative suppliers.

**Requirements**

* Proven record of taking new packaging concepts or technologies from prototype to industrial launch.
* Hands-on experience of pilot tooling, functional testing and formula/pack compatibility.
* Strong knowledge of materials, mechanisms and processes (injection, blow molding, assembly, decoration).
* Experience building platforms, standards or design rules used by development teams.
* Working knowledge of the EU PPWR and design-for-recycling guidelines (e.g., RecyClass).
* Network of innovative packaging suppliers and technology partners in Europe and Asia.
* Track record of building business cases and prioritizing with clear criteria.
* Able to review CAD models; experience with 3D printing and rapid prototyping.
* Track record of building a new function from scratch, with a curious, rigorous and evidence-based approach.
* 8+ years in packaging development, including significant pre-development or innovation experience in beauty, fragrance or luxury.
* Bachelor's/Master's in Packaging, Mechanical, Materials or Plastics Engineering, or Industrial Design.

**Benefits**

* Monthly "Self Love Days" - at company discretion
* Premium Medical/Dental/Vision coverage for employee plus dependents
* Monthly coaching sessions with our in-house Success Coach
* Employee discounts on all Huda Beauty products
* Quarterly product gifting

*Huda Beauty is committed to building diverse and inclusive teams and upholding an equal employment workplace that is free from discrimination. We hire stellar individuals regardless of their race, color, ancestry, religion, gender identity, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, medical conditions, disability, or veteran status. If you need reasonable accommodations at any point in the application or interview process, please let us know.*

jobs.title: Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai is looking for a Marketing Manager to join our Marketing team.
  
  
Are you a master of craft? Do you thrive in a team that succeeds together, demonstrating integrity and respect while acting responsibly? Do you embrace a growth mindset? We invite you to become a fan of the exceptional.
  
  
Mandarin Oriental is the award-winning owner and operator of some of the most luxurious hotels, resorts and residences located in prime destinations around the world, with a strong development pipeline. Increasingly recognised for creating some of the world’s most sought-after properties, the Group provides legendary service inspired by Asian heritage whilst representing the very cutting-edge of luxury experiences.
  
  
Located within Wasl Tower on Sheikh Zayed Road, Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai offers an elevated expression of modern hospitality in the heart of the city. Designed by UNStudio, the tower sets a distinctive architectural tone, while the hotel’s 259 guestrooms and suites reflect contemporary, design-led living with panoramic views across the Dubai skyline. The hotel’s dining portfolio includes Yù & Mì, Chitarra, Noia by the Pool, as well as Majestas Group concepts Billionaire, Lion in the Sun and FB1, with forthcoming openings including Osaka, Pavyllon Dubai by Yannick Alléno, and a street-level urban eatery. Additional features include a rooftop helipad, a two-storey spa and wellness sanctuary, landscaped rooftop pools and versatile event spaces. The Residences at Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai are set to open by 2027.
  
  
**About The Job**
Based at the Mandarin Oriental Downtown, Dubai within the Marketing department in Dubai, the Marketing Manager is responsible to oversee integrated marketing, brand governance, digital ecosystem, performance marketing, CRM, and social media, while managing campaign planning, execution, content production, optimisation, tracking, and performance reporting. The role is also responsible to drive strategic marketing plans with a creative and commercially focused approach, ensuring brand consistency and revenue growth across Rooms, F&B, and Spa. Marketing Manager reports to the Director of Marketing & Communications.
  
  
**As a Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for the following duties:**

* Develop and execute an integrated annual marketing plan with the Marketing & Communications Director, aligned with commercial strategy, revenue objectives, and optimised budget allocation for maximum ROI.
* Lead and oversee multi-channel marketing campaigns, ensuring consistent execution, strong performance, and full compliance with brand standards across all touchpoints.
* Manage and optimise the hotel’s digital ecosystem (social media, CRM, CMS, and performance marketing) to drive visibility, engagement, and conversion, alongside high-quality content production aligned with brand positioning.
* Monitor, analyse, and report on campaign performance against KPIs and budgets, using insights, testing, and data-driven optimisation to continuously improve results and inform strategy.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with PR & Communications, Sales, F&B, and other departments to deliver integrated initiatives and maximise commercial impact across all business units.
* Identify new marketing opportunities and trends, while managing external agencies and developing team members to ensure innovation, high-quality delivery, and sustained performance.

**As a Marketing Manager, we expect from you:**

* Minimum 5 years of marketing experience, ideally within luxury hospitality, luxury brands, or high-end lifestyle sectors.
* Strong understanding of the Middle East market, with proven expertise in digital strategy and performance marketing.
* Well-developed sense of brand image and visual identity, with hands-on experience managing content production, photoshoots, and creative assets.
* Fluent in English; knowledge of Arabic is an advantage.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, multicultural environment.
* Highly organised with strong time management, attention to detail, and problem-solving capabilities.

**Our commitment to you**

* Learning & Development. Your success is our success. We craft unique learning and development programmes for various stages in your career so that you grow, continuously.
* MOstay. When you work as hard as our colleagues do, it’s important to take time off. As a member of the #MOfamily, you can stay with us wherever you go in the world. The MOstay programme offers complimentary nights and additionally attractive rates on rooms for you and your loved ones.
* Heath & Colleague Wellness. Finding the right work-life balance is important. Your wellbeing matters to us. A variety of health benefits and wellness programmes are offered to all our colleagues, globally.
* Colleague Comfort and Convenience: Benefit from comfortable accommodation, a duty transportation, and duty meals to ensure your work experience is both enjoyable and hassle-free.
* Competitive Salary and Benefits: We offer a competitive salary and an attractive benefits package, fully aligned with UAE industry standards, to ensure your financial well-being and stability.

**We’re Fans. Are you?**

jobs.title: Regional Marketing Manager, HHC
jobs.description:
Interested in a career that matters?
  
  
Are you passionate about shaping growth strategies that help customers create more sustainable and effective household care solutions? Join the PHB MEIA Marketing & New Channels team, an integrated regional function bringing together Regional Marketing, Strategic Intelligence & MarCom, Commercial Excellence, and Inside Sales to accelerate business growth across the Middle East, India, and Africa.
  
  
As Regional Marketing Manager, Household Care, you will own the regional industry strategy and growth agenda for Laundry, Dishwash, and Professional Cleaning across MEIA. Working in a highly collaborative matrix organization, you will help translate strategy into focused commercial actions, innovation priorities, and measurable business outcomes while supporting Novonesis' mission of creating impact through biosolutions.
  
  
The Role & Your Impact
  
  
This is a regional strategic individual contributor role with significant influence across markets, customer segments, and functions. You will connect customer, market, competitive, and business insights to drive commercial choices, portfolio priorities, and growth initiatives across the Household Care industry in MEIA.
  
  
Key responsibilities include:
  
  

* Own and drive the regional Household Care industry strategy across Laundry, Dishwash, and Professional Cleaning.
* Translate Global and Business Unit strategies into regional growth priorities, Must Win Battles, portfolio choices, and innovation direction.
* Develop recommendations on portfolio priorities, value propositions, pricing perspectives, customer segmentation, and go-to-market approaches.
* Integrate customer, market, competitive, and business insights to support strategic decision-making.
* Represent the Household Care agenda in regional and global forums and guide discussions on opportunities, threats, and resource priorities.
* Mobilize and align cross-functional teams to convert strategic choices into measurable business impact.
* Partner closely with Sales, Business Units, Innovation, Technical Service, Strategic Intelligence & MarCom, Commercial Excellence, Inside Sales, and Global Marketing stakeholders.

What You'll Need to Be Successful
  
  
**Must-have Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree, or equivalent relevant experience, in Marketing, Business, Science, Engineering, Chemistry, Biotechnology, or a related field.
* Significant experience in strategic marketing, business development, industry/category management, portfolio management, or commercial leadership within a B2B environment.
* Proven ability to translate customer, market, competitive, and business insights into strategies and commercial decisions.
* Strong commercial judgment and experience influencing stakeholders across functions.
* Fluency in English.

**Essential Competencies**

* Strategic thinking and growth leadership.
* Commercial judgment and business acumen.
* Customer and market orientation.
* Influence and cross-functional leadership.
* Adaptability and execution focus.

**Additional Skills & Interests We Value**
The following are preferred qualifications and are not required:
  
  

* Experience within biosolutions, ingredients, Household Care, detergents, cleaning products, consumer goods, chemicals, or related industries.
* Experience with portfolio management, pricing, customer segmentation, value proposition development, or innovation commercialization.
* Experience working across diverse markets, customer segments, or global matrix organizations.
* Knowledge of MEIA markets and/or additional regional languages.
* Experience using CRM platforms, commercial analytics, market intelligence, or marketing technology tools.
* Curiosity about consumer trends, sustainability, and innovation-driven growth.

What We Offer
  
  
At Novonesis, you'll have the opportunity to influence the strategic direction of an important growth industry across a diverse and dynamic region. You will work alongside talented commercial, marketing, technical, and innovation professionals while contributing to initiatives that create value for customers and support sustainable growth.
  
  
You'll benefit from:
  
  

* The opportunity to shape regional strategy and industry priorities.
* Exposure to senior regional and global stakeholders.
* A collaborative and inclusive culture that values different perspectives.
* Opportunities for development, learning, and professional growth.
* The chance to create scalable impact through biosolutions and innovation.

In this role, you will:
  
  

* Work closely with regional and global stakeholders across multiple functions.
* Navigate a complex matrix organization and lead through influence rather than formal authority.
* Balance strategic thinking with execution and business impact.
* Travel as required for customer meetings, market visits, industry events, and internal business forums based on business needs.

**Our purpose guides the way**
In Novonesis, we know that solutions rooted in biology can help solve humanity’s biggest challenges. Since we began more than a century ago, this has been our guide. It’s how we've gotten so far. And it’s how we'll impact the future. Now, more than ever, the world needs change. And with biosolutions, the possibilities for transformation are endless. If our purpose resonates with you, we encourage you to apply.
  
  
**Opportunities for everyone**
We are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equal opportunity for all applicants. Therefore we ask you to apply without a cover letter or photo and instead include a few sentences in your CV explaining your motivation for applying.
  
  
We make all employment decisions based on business needs and welcome candidates with a wide range of backgrounds, including ethnicity, religion, gender, sexual orientation, age, disability, or veteran status.
  
  
**Explore Other Openings**
If this position isn’t the right fit, you may still find other opportunities with us. You’re welcome to explore open roles or create a job agent to stay connected with future opportunities at novonesis.com/Career

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Executive
jobs.description:
**Senior Marketing Executive**

Location: India; Dubai, United Arab Emirates | Experience: Mid - Senior · 2–10 years · Full-time · On-site · 2 openings

**About the Company**

Timeless Group of Companies is a family-owned retail, distribution, trading, and investment group based in Dubai, founded in 2003. Its aim is to empower and elevate established and emerging brands in the retail world through distribution and strategic brand-building services. The group holds exclusive distribution, procurement, and master-franchise rights for premium and luxury international fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands across the Middle East and adjacent regions, reaching more than 300 GCC channels through subsidiaries including Times Square Group and J.S.K Trading Limited. Timeless also invests in earlystage ventures and operates a real-estate division. Its vision is to be a go-to partner for retail and distribution solutions, recognized for excellence, integrity, and fostering a community of thriving brands. The company’s values include people, honesty, creativity, transparency, operations, and leadership. It describes its multicultural team as a source of creativity and innovation, and emphasizes inclusion, mentorship, and equitable opportunity.

**About the Role**

Timeless Group of Companies is hiring two full-time marketing professionals for on-site work in Dubai, reporting to the Head of Marketing. The role focuses on integrated marketing across retail, fashion, and sports, connecting brand-building activity with commercial objectives. You will plan sports brand activations, manage retail marketing initiatives, and coordinate digital, social, and content activity across channels. Working with internal stakeholders, agencies, and partners, you will lead cross-functional projects, manage campaign budgets and timelines, and use market research and performance analytics to identify insights and improve results. The position calls for a marketing background and English-language communication, with experience suited to a mid-to-senior professional. You will contribute to campaigns that build awareness for international brands and support their regional market presence.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop integrated marketing campaigns that build brand awareness across relevant channels, aligning plans and execution with commercial objectives and the needs of retail, fashion, and sports brands.
* Plan sports brand activations and manage retail marketing initiatives, coordinating the activity, stakeholders, and timing required to deliver consistent experiences across channels.
* Oversee digital and social content, coordinating its development and publication to support campaign goals and maintain clear, consistent brand communication.
* Analyze campaign performance and market research, turning results and audience insights into practical recommendations that inform future marketing activity.
* Coordinate agency and partner relationships, sharing campaign priorities and managing collaboration to support timely, aligned marketing delivery.
* Lead cross-functional marketing projects while managing budgets and timelines, keeping stakeholders aligned and activity focused on agreed commercial objectives.

**Essential Skills & Technologies**

* Marketing strategy and campaign management skills, including the ability to develop integrated plans and align marketing activity with commercial objectives.
* Sports marketing and retail marketing capability, with an understanding of brand activations and initiatives that support retail and apparel brands.
* Brand management experience, including building awareness and maintaining consistent brand communication across relevant channels.
* Digital marketing, social media marketing, and content marketing skills to oversee channel activity and support integrated campaigns.
* Market research and marketing analytics capability, including interpreting campaign performance and translating findings into actionable insights.
* Stakeholder management and team leadership skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional projects, agencies, and partners.
* A marketing field of study and professional English communication skills to support marketing planning and collaboration.

**Additional Plus**

* Experience working across premium or luxury fashion, sports, or lifestyle brands would be useful in the group’s retail and distribution environment.
* Familiarity with international brands and regional market expansion could support work across the company’s Middle East and adjacent-region activities.

**What You'll Bring**

* You bring a marketing background and experience appropriate to a mid-to-senior marketing professional, with the ability to contribute across campaign planning and delivery.
* You can balance brand-building priorities with commercial objectives, using market research and campaign insights to shape practical marketing decisions.
* You communicate effectively in English and can work with stakeholders, agencies, partners, and crossfunctional colleagues to move marketing projects forward.
* You can coordinate campaign budgets and timelines while maintaining focus on quality, consistency, and delivery across channels.

**Why Join Us**

At Timeless Group of Companies, you can contribute to the growth of established and emerging brands through retail, distribution, and strategic brand-building work. The group’s portfolio spans premium and luxury fashion, sports, and lifestyle, with opportunities to engage with international brands and regional market expansion. Its reach across more than 300 GCC channels gives marketing activity a connection to a broad regional distribution network. As a family-run business with more than 20 years of market legacy, Timeless combines long-standing industry experience with an emphasis on creativity, collaboration, and hands-on leadership. The company highlights career growth, training and development, and mentorship from experienced industry professionals. Its multicultural team and stated commitment to inclusion and equitable opportunity support a workplace that values different perspectives. You can work across marketing initiatives that connect brand awareness, retail activity, and commercial objectives, while collaborating with internal stakeholders, agencies, and partners. The group’s values—people, honesty, creativity, transparency, operations, and leadership—provide a clear foundation for how it seeks to build relationships and develop thriving brands.

**What We Offer**

* Exposure to premium and luxury fashion, sports, and lifestyle brands, with opportunities to contribute to brand-building and regional market expansion.
* Career growth, training and development, and mentorship from industry professionals, including mentors with more than 25 years of experience.

A collaborative, multicultural workplace that emphasizes inclusion, creativity, hands-on leadership, and equitable opportunity.

jobs.title: Product Manager - Talent & Culture

**Growth is our default:**
We treat capability as built, not innate. A static skills model can’t keep pace with our market. Growth here isn’t just a buzzword in a slide deck, it’s hardwired into the design of every single role.
  
  
**Radical Personalization:**
We’ve scrapped the traditional corporate ladder. We resource your growth by putting you in control of your own career trajectory, empowering you with the funding and peer support to forge your own path.
  
  
**Unfiltered Authenticity:**
AI can automate speed and polish, but it can't automate real human contribution. We foster a culture of direct feedback and raw authenticity because the unique edge you bring is our greatest competitive advantage.
  
  
**WHAT'S ON YOUR PLATE?**
**Design authentic people experiences & products:**
Go beyond tech platforms to build a comprehensive ecosystem of
**human experiences**
. You will design a diverse portfolio of touchpoints; from cultural rituals and growth moments to seamless teamwork that remove friction and empower our people to bring their whole, unfiltered selves to work and unlock their absolute full potential.
  
  

* Build strong, trust-based relationships across your squad to accelerate execution and raise the quality of decisions
* Collaborate closely with business leaders and People Partners to uncover unmet employee needs and identify opportunities

* Build for Scale: Rapidly ideate, prototype, and test solutions that work across highly diverse roles, seniority levels, and country contexts.
* Drive Cross-Functional Execution: Collaborate and own the dependency map.
* Define Success & Own the Metrics: Define what "working" means before products are launched. You will report against these honestly, including when a launched experience underperforms and needs to be killed or re-scoped.
* Influence & Enable Change: Partner with leaders and People Partners to drive adoption plans, comms, and manager enablement, because even a captive internal user base needs to be won over.

**WHAT DID WE ORDER?**
**Who You Are. And What You Like.**
**You are deeply invested in human potential and the mechanics of collective genius. You know that culture is the ultimate competitive advantage, and you understand the sheer impact that healthy, highly effective teams can create.**
**You are fast, agile and driven.**
You're an experienced Product Manager with at least 5 years of work experience in Product Management.
  
  

* You have successfully launched products to market or to a large internal user base
* You have strong understanding of Agile product management and a solid grasp of the responsibilities of empowered product teams
* You demonstrated fantastic verbal and written communication skills, easily engaging with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior leadership
* You thrive in cross-functional teams and excel in a collaborative environment
* You are experienced in finding and defining solutions based on research, data, and insights

**About Al-Futtaim**

With more than 40,000 employees, Al-Futtaim represents over 200 of the world’s most recognised brands, including Toyota, Lexus, IKEA, ACE and Marks & Spencer. Overview of the role
  
  
The Product Manager will lead the end-to-end product agenda for Hyundai Commercial Vehicles, covering trucks, buses and fleet solutions across the UAE.
  
  
The role is responsible for product strategy, specifications, pricing, ordering, tender preparation, regulatory requirements, new product launches and product profitability. You will work closely with Hyundai and internal teams to turn customer needs and market insights into commercially competitive products and solutions.
  
  
Success in this role requires strong commercial vehicle technical knowledge, commercial judgement, analytical capability and disciplined product management.
  
  
What you will do
  
  

* Own the Hyundai Commercial Vehicles product roadmap, including models, specifications, applications, customer segments and launch priorities.
* Develop business cases, landed-cost calculations, pricing recommendations and profitability analysis for individual models.
* Analyse competitor products, specifications, pricing, warranty, availability and total cost of ownership to strengthen market positioning.
* Translate sales pipelines, tenders and market demand into product and ordering recommendations.
* Manage product-related coordination with Hyundai, including specifications, pricing support, technical clarifications, production allocation and product changes.
* Coordinate UAE homologation, registration and technical documentation requirements.
* Lead new product launches from business case and ordering through pricing, training and market introduction.
* Develop fit-for-purpose commercial vehicle solutions by evaluating payload, axle configuration, wheelbase, powertrain, body interface and customer operating requirements.
* Maintain accurate product, specification, pricing and order information within SAP.
* Prepare technically compliant tenders, including specifications, costing, pricing, compliance requirements and risk identification.

**Required Skills To Be Successful**

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering.
* Minimum 5 years of recent product management, product planning or technical product experience in trucks, buses or fleet solutions within the UAE or GCC.
* Demonstrated experience in commercial vehicle specifications, pricing, landed-cost, gross-margin and tender analysis.
* Valid UAE driving licence.

What equips you for the role
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering is mandatory.
* Minimum 8 years of automotive or commercial vehicle experience overall.
* At least 5 years of experience in product management, product planning, technical sales or portfolio strategy.
* UAE or GCC experience within trucks, buses or fleet solutions.
* Strong understanding of payload, axle configuration, wheelbase, powertrain, body interfaces and vehicle applications.
* Experience with landed-cost calculations, pricing, gross margin and product-level business cases.
* Experience working with vehicle manufacturers on specifications, pricing, orders, production allocation and new product launches.
* Working knowledge of UAE vehicle homologation and registration requirements.
* Experience managing product and material master data in SAP.
* Experience preparing technically compliant commercial vehicle tenders.
* Advanced Excel, PowerPoint and SAP or enterprise resource planning capability.
* Professional written and spoken business English; Arabic is preferred.
* Strong analytical, presentation, negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.
  
  
With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.
  
  
Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.
  
  
Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.
  
  
Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

jobs.description:
**About Fanatics Momentum**
Fanatics Momentum is building the UAE's leading regulated commercial gaming operator. Licensed by the General Commercial Gaming Regulatory Authority (GCGRA), we operate across lottery, iGaming, sportsbook, and digital content, combining Momentum's regional foundation with Fanatics' global product, technology, and scale. The business is ambitious, well-resourced, and moving fast. If you want to help build a category-defining operator in one of the world's most exciting regulated gaming markets, this is the right time to join.
  
  
**Overview**
As a Principal Product Manager, Lottery, you’ll be the Lottery expert in our product team: the person who turns our Lottery vision and roadmap into product that ships, as we build a modern lottery proposition for the UAE.
  
  
Your challenge: How do we make the lottery easy to join, exciting to play every week and rewarding to come back to?
  
  
You’ll own a substantial Lottery domain across draw games, instant games, the player journey and engagement, working closely with Product Design, Engineering, Commercial, CRM, Lottery Operations and Compliance.
  
  
You’ll report to the Product Director, Lottery & Casino, who sets the Lottery vision and the big bets. From there to launch is yours: breaking each roadmap item down into clear requirements, prioritizing and sequencing the work with engineering, and making sure what ships lands well with customers. We’re looking for someone who can be trusted to carry an item from a one-line roadmap entry to a live, measured release.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a Lottery specialist first, with a deep working knowledge of draw-game design, prize structures, jackpots and instant games. They’re also commercially minded, data-led, hands-on with delivery and comfortable moving quickly in a regulated environment. You know how to balance customer needs, commercial outcomes and a compelling product experience across a portfolio of games and channels.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
What you’ll own:
  
  

* The Lottery roadmap: shaping it with the Product Director, turning each item into prioritized, delivery-ready requirements, and championing it through to launch
* Draw game design: matrices, prize structures and jackpot mechanics
* Instant games, including scratchcards and e-Instants
* New game launches, including game certification and regulatory approval
* Draw-day and results experience
* Winner journey, prize claims and payouts
* Subscriptions, syndicates and repeat play
* Digital and retail channel experience
* Responsible gambling built into Lottery product design, not added afterwards
* Cross-sell with Casino and Sportsbook
* Experimentation and product performance

**Within 12 Months, You Will Have**

* Grown active players and repeat play, with responsible gambling safeguards designed in
* Improved sign-up, first purchase and retention
* Launched new games and meaningful new capabilities
* Created a clearer, more engaging Lottery experience across digital and retail
* Established clear customer and commercial metrics

**Required Qualifications**

* 7+ years of Product Management experience across consumer digital products.
* Deep, hands-on Lottery product experience at a lottery operator, lottery supplier or digital lottery platform. Experience limited to casino, sportsbook or social gaming will not be sufficient on its own.
* Subject-matter depth across Lottery: draw-game mathematics (matrix design, odds, prize tiers, payout percentage), fixed and pari-mutuel prizes, rolling and progressive jackpots, instant games, raffles, and draw and prize-claim operations.
* Experience owning substantial product domains end to end.
* A track record of personally breaking roadmap items into epics, user stories and acceptance criteria, and working day to day with engineering squads and delivery partners to ship them.
* Strong product craft across customer discovery, experimentation, onboarding and payments journeys, retention, personalization and consumer UX.
* Strong commercial and analytical mindset, with experience using data to inform product decisions and measure performance.
* Experience working and moving quickly within a regulated environment, including game certification, regulatory change control and responsible gambling requirements.
* Experience working cross-functionally with Product Design, Engineering, Commercial, CRM, Operations and Compliance.
* Experience leveraging AI to accelerate product discovery, analysis, experimentation and delivery.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience in national or state lottery operations, subscriptions and syndicates, raffles, instant win games, retail lottery channels, native lottery apps, or international regulated gaming.

*If you possess some of these qualifications but not all of them, we still encourage you to apply!*
At Fanatics Momentum, we’re proud to be a fair, transparent, and inclusive employer. We value diversity, collaboration, and innovation, and we’re committed to creating an environment where every team member can thrive. If you’re ready to grow your career and help us build Momentum, we’d love to hear from you.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager , AI-First (Remote)
jobs.description:
**Ready to lead Puffy’s campaigns, using AI to understand customers and create ads that win new business?**

**Total Annual Package:**
Up to USD $143,000 + comprehensive benefits (Base salary + monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base)

**Location**
: Remote (Global)

**Potential career path:**
Marketing Manager, AI-First → Senior Marketing Manager → Marketing Director / Head of Marketing.

Career progression that takes 4-5 years elsewhere can happen in 1-2 years here for high performers.

**The Opportunity:**

Puffy is a technology-driven e-commerce business with over $1 billion in lifetime sales, powered by analytics, data and artificial intelligence. Our teams bring together software development, quality assurance, machine learning and AI, marketing, design, conversion rate optimisation, talent augmentation, HR, operations, legal, finance and customer success.

As our Marketing Manager, AI-First, you’ll own consumer research and campaign strategy, turning customer motivations and market evidence into campaign ideas, creative briefs and video scripts. You’ll use AI across research and creative development, collaborate with creative and paid-channel teams, and apply performance learning to improve the next campaign. Reporting to the Director of Marketing, you’ll also develop strategic growth partnerships as a secondary focus.

This is an individual contributor role with no direct reports.

**The Problems You'll Own:**

* **Primary: Give shoppers a reason to choose Puffy.**
  Buying a mattress online means making a decision without trying it first. Which question is holding shoppers back, and what could an ad show them to answer it?
* **Secondary: Find partners who reach the right shoppers.**
  An affiliate or publisher may have a large audience without reaching people considering a mattress. Decide which opportunities to recommend and whether the results justify another project.

**What You'll Own:**

* **Consumer research:**
  Study shoppers’ buying decisions, competitor messaging and market trends. Use what you learn to recommend which customer need the next campaign should address.
* **Creative briefs and scripts:**
  Use AI to compare messages, then write briefs and ad scripts for the AI video, design and content teams. Check each claim against the product and Puffy’s brand, and link to your AI review in every creative proposal.
* **Campaign performance:**
  Work with paid-channel teams to launch the creative. Compare audience response with what you expected, then decide what to keep or change in the next brief.
* **Growth partnerships:**
  Use AI to research potential partners and verify the evidence yourself. Coordinate selected exclusive affiliate projects and review the results with marketing leadership.

Campaign strategy comes first. The paid-channel teams run the media; you own the creative recommendation and how the results inform the next campaign.

**What This Can Mean for Your Career:**

You’ll see whether the shopper question you chose, the product benefit you highlighted and the script you wrote made a difference once the ad ran. That experience can prepare you to set priorities across several campaigns, not just write the next brief.

**What You'll Need:**

* At least 5 years in marketing, including 2 or more years with direct-to-consumer (D2C) e-commerce brands. Offline or store-only marketing experience does not meet that requirement.
* Experience turning consumer research into campaign ideas. Be ready to explain what you personally owned, how you measured the result and what you changed afterward.
* An understanding of how targeting, messaging and creative work together on Meta and Google, including Google Search and Demand Gen.
* The ability to write ad copy, video scripts and briefs a creative team can act on, and to use AI for research and drafting without relying on it to verify its own work.
* Experience supporting strategic growth partnerships, such as affiliate or publisher relationships. You don’t need to be an affiliate specialist.
* The ability to lead a project independently and coordinate work with creative teams, paid-channel teams and external partners.
* Must be willing to work extended hours and weekends as needed.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience with an online mattress brand is a plus. We also welcome applicants from other D2C e-commerce brands.

**The Resources to Build On:**

Puffy has been AI-first since December 2023. You’ll have company-provided AI tools, including ChatGPT and Claude, AI agents, bots, plugins, AI projects and automations through platforms such as n8n. You’ll also receive relevant department tools, data, assets and specialist support. Use them to test different ways to tell a product story; you’re responsible for making sure the final script rings true for the shopper and represents the product accurately.

**The Puffy DNA:**

We're restless, perpetually hungry, and fast-paced, driven by an unwavering belief that we can outperform any competitor, regardless of their size.

* Be the Owner: We don't hire employees; we welcome owners. You're accountable for results, not activity.
* Execute with Urgency: We thrive in high-stakes environments by making thoughtful decisions quickly and acting decisively.
* Demand Excellence: We solve the hard problems that others can't, pushing the boundaries of our craft.
* Be AI-First: Daily multi-turn AI conversations challenge your assumptions.
* Go All-In: When the mission demands it, we rally as one team to cross the finish line.

**✨ Your Total Compensation & Benefits:**

**💰 Compensation:**

* Up to USD $143,000 total annual cash compensation.
* Base salary up to USD $130,000/year plus a monthly performance bonus of up to 10% of base.
* Annual salary review every January.

**🏥 Health & Protection:**

* Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance

**🌴 Time Off:**

* Generous Paid Time Off (PTO) + US public holidays

**💼 Work Environment:**

* AI-First organization with access to AI-native tool stack
* **Remote First:**
  Work from the comfort of your home office
* Up to $5,000 annual learning budget for courses and certifications
* International team collaboration across 16+ nationalities. Your assumptions get challenged daily.

**🏆 Rewards & Recognition:**

* Eligibility for selection to the Leaders Club, an elite recognition program featuring premium wellness memberships, exclusive networking with senior leadership, and annual leadership retreats
* Eligibility for nomination as 'We Are' Champion of the Month, monthly recognition with gift vouchers and company-wide celebration for exceptional contributions

**Ready to Put Your Expertise to Work?**

Click “Apply” to submit your application. Tell us about a campaign brief or ad script you wrote: what customer insight shaped it, how you used AI and checked its suggestions, and what the campaign results taught you.

In this capacity, you will provide product insights to identify key priorities and growth opportunities for Cartier KSA. This includes defining annual targets for each product category and driving both the visibility and performance of the product portfolio while also supporting client acquisition, engagement and loyalty objectives.

  

As a key pillar of the KSA Marketing, Communication and Clients team, you will translates the overall product market plan into comprehensive, 360-degree action rollouts, guaranteeing effective implementation across all relevant channels and lead a team of three.

jobs.description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION**

**ABOUT AL RABIE SAUDI FOODS**

Al Rabie Saudi Foods is one of the largest Saudi companies and most trusted juice and beverage manufacturers, producing a diverse portfolio of 100% juices, nectars, dairy beverages, and functional drinks distributed across Saudi Arabia and many international markets. Headquartered in Riyadh, Al Rabie has built a legacy of quality and innovation that is deeply embedded in Saudi households. As the company strengthens its position across the Kingdom’s retail landscape, we are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Key Account Executive to ensure flawless in-store execution and reliable order collection across major Modern Trade retail partners.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

Reporting to the Modern Trade Supervisor, the Key Account Executive is responsible for delivering flawless in-store execution across assigned Modern Trade stores. The role focuses on order collection, on-shelf availability, and the execution of store fundamentals as per account agreements – including planogram compliance, pricing accuracy, shelving and facings, promotional execution, and expiry management. It is a hands-on, store-based role and an excellent development opportunity for an ambitious professional looking to build a career in the Modern Trade channel within a leading FMCG business.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

1. **Order Collection & Availability:**

* Visit assigned Modern Trade stores as per the agreed journey plan and collect accurate orders to secure continuous product availability.
* Check stock levels on shelf and in the back store, raising replenishment orders to prevent out-of-stocks and lost sales.
* Ensure full distribution of the agreed product range and pack formats across each assigned store.
* Identify and secure opportunities to expand distribution, facings, and shelf presence at store level.

**2. Store Fundamentals & Planogram Compliance:**

* Ensure all store fundamentals are executed in line with account agreements, including planograms, shelving, facings, and product blocking.
* Verify that shelf layouts match the agreed planogram and correct any deviations during each store visit.
* Maintain clean, well-organized, and fully stocked shelves and displays that meet Al Rabie’s merchandising standards.
* Secure and maintain agreed prime shelf positioning, secondary displays, and branded equipment placement.

**3. Pricing & Promotion Execution:**

* Ensure correct and up-to-date pricing and shelf tags on all Al Rabie products as per the agreed price list.
* Execute agreed promotions and activations accurately and on time, ensuring correct promotional pricing at shelf.
* Ensure promotional materials and branded displays are correctly installed and clearly visible to shoppers.
* Monitor competitor pricing and promotional activity in-store and report findings to the Modern Trade Supervisor.

**4. Freshness & Expiry Management:**

* Apply strict stock rotation (FIFO/FEFO) on shelf and in the back store to guarantee product freshness for shoppers.
* Identify and remove near-expiry, expired, or damaged stock from the shelf, following the agreed returns and swap process.
* Track and report expiry risks and returns to the Modern Trade Supervisor to enable timely corrective action.
* Uphold Al Rabie’s quality and freshness standards at every point of the store visit.

**5. Customer Coordination & Store Relationships:**

* Build strong day-to-day working relationships with store managers, section heads, and receiving staff to facilitate smooth execution.
* Handle routine store queries, order follow-ups, and delivery or service issues, escalating as needed to the Modern Trade Supervisor.
* Coordinate deliveries and returns with the store and supply chain to ensure continuous product availability.
* Follow up on outstanding actions and agreements to ensure timely resolution at store level.

**6. Reporting & Asset Care**

* Accurately record orders, visits, availability, pricing, and expiry data using the sales-force automation tool on every store visit.
* Provide daily field feedback on execution, out-of-stocks, and competitor activity to the Modern Trade Supervisor.
* Care for and safeguard company assets in-store, including branded chillers, display units, and merchandising equipment.
* Follow all company policies, trade agreements, and health & safety standards during store operations.

**KEY REQUIREMENTS**

1. **Experience:**

* 2–4 years in Modern Trade, retail sales, or merchandising roles within FMCG.
* Hands-on experience with store-level execution and order collection, Food & Beverage preferred.
* KSA market experience (required)
* Valid KSA driving license (required)

1. **Skills & Attributes**

* Good numerical skills with strong attention to detail
* Comfortable using handheld / sales-force automation devices for order taking and reporting
* Well-organized, proactive, and able to manage a full store route each day
* Basic knowledge of merchandising and planogram principles

1. **Personal Attributes**

* Hands-on, energetic, and comfortable spending the full day in stores
* Ambitious and eager to build a career in the Modern Trade channel
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills

Fluent in Arabic and English (required)

**Why Join Al Rabie?**

At Al Rabie Saudi Foods, we believe that great brands are built on great people. We offer a dynamic, growth-oriented environment where commercial talent is empowered to make a real impact on a category-leading portfolio trusted by millions of Saudi families every day. This is your opportunity to launch and grow your career in the Modern Trade channel with one of the Kingdom’s most iconic beverage brands, backed by a strong commercial team and the ambition to win on every shelf.
