Join Thoughtworks at the beginning of our next chapter in the Middle East. KSA and the UAE are strategic growth markets for us, fueled by ambitious national agendas around AI, digital government, data, and economic transformation, such as Vision 2030. We are looking for an experienced Product Leader to join our fast-growing local team in Riyadh.
  
  
This isn't about joining a large, established operation; this is a chance to shape something from the beginning. In this founding phase, you will have the genuine opportunity to help build our teams, propositions, culture, and client relationships from an early stage, all backed by Thoughtworks' global depth in product, design, engineering, data, and AI.
  
  
As a trusted advisor to senior client leadership, you will partner with ambitious executives and entrepreneurial founders to convert bold visions into market-ready, production-grade products and experiences at pace. Operating at the intersection of business strategy, human-centered design, and emerging technology, you will lead fast-paced, multidisciplinary lean AI-first pods for clients and activate business growth through consultative pre-sales and account expansion in high-growth markets. You will champion the 333 methodology, our rapid delivery framework to accelerate product concepting, validation, and build cycles.
  
  
Job responsibilities

* Establish the market and competitive landscape, go-to-market strategy, and business case or economic model for unprecedented client opportunities.
* Lead modern product development practices within autonomous, cross-functional pods (Product, Design, Engineering), integrating AI across the entire product lifecycle - from accelerated discovery and research to AI-first delivery.
* Provide hands-on leadership within lean pods to drive multidisciplinary teams towards high-impact outcomes.
* Lead large, complex programmes across multiple workstreams and stakeholder groups, owning strategy, roadmap, scope, and outcomes end to end.
* Lead growth initiatives by shaping client engagements, authoring high-impact proposals, delivering executive pitches, and running strategic discovery workshops that establish a trusted advisory footprint.
* Own and contribute to account growth targets, identifying opportunities to expand existing client relationships into new engagements and revenue streams in this strategic growth market.

* 8+ years of product leadership driving new product launches, commercialisation, and production-scale growth of digital products and platforms, including building and leading high-performing, multidisciplinary product organisations.
* End-to-end expertise launching net-new products to market - navigating discovery, framing value propositions, leading rapid cross-functional pods, driving go-to-market strategies, and establishing monetisation models to achieve product-market fit before scaling.
* Depth in conducting research and leveraging market trends, customer insights, and competitive intelligence to facilitate strategic ideation and identify opportunities for growth.
* Expertise in developing value propositions for digital and AI products, using lean, innovative approaches to test viability, feasibility, and desirability.
* Deep commercial acumen spanning pre-sales, engagement structuring, unit economics, monetisation strategies, and organic account expansion - connecting technological innovation directly to ROI and business value.
* Proven ability to operate at company, portfolio, and product levels - defining and executing strategy, shaping a vision, and translating it into a roadmap with clear, value-based measures of success.
* Ability to advise clients on becoming a value-driven, customer-centric product organisation and drive change by introducing best practices in product management, value delivery, and measurement.
* Fluency in leveraging AI tools and platforms to transform the end-to-end product development lifecycle - accelerating market research, user discovery, prototyping, spec generation, automated testing, and performance analytics.

Professional Skills
  
  

* Skilled at operating and building relationships with C-suite executives, with the confidence to drive conversations at the intersection of technology, product, business, and transformation.
* Experience with consultative selling and senior client leadership - diagnosing client needs, co-creating solutions, and building trusted-advisor relationships that convert into long-term engagements rather than transactional sales.
* Exceptional storytelling, negotiation, and workshop facilitation skills, with a proven track record of guiding demanding executive stakeholders and entrepreneurial clients through rapid, ambiguous builds.
* Passionate about being a visible external voice for the practice - speaking at conferences and contributing to industry panels or publications to build our brand presence in the Middle East.
* A builder mindset with a strong inclination to work collaboratively alongside multidisciplinary teams, leading by example.
* A curious, open mindset that challenges established ways of working, energised by helping build a new Thoughtworks business from an early stage and reimagining the product development lifecycle for a faster-paced, AI-enabled era.

Other things to know

There is no one-size-fits-all career path at Thoughtworks: however you want to develop your career is entirely up to you. But we also balance autonomy with the strength of our cultivation culture. jobs.title: Assistant Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
**Job Purpose:**

The Marketing Assistant Manager is a pivotal role within KFC Marketing team, responsible for executing campaigns, promotions, and new product launches flawlessly, supporting brand strategy while protecting store operations and guest experience.

The role aims to drive brand growth, market share, and consumer engagement by collaborating with cross-functional teams and ensuring seamless execution of marketing initiatives. A key focus is driving sales growth across all channels, including aggregators, through strategic planning, data-driven decision-making, and precise, on-time execution.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Brand & Marketing Strategy**

* Assist in developing and implementing short- and long-term brand strategies to achieve business objectives, including transaction growth, sales volume, and profitability.
* Support the execution of marketing campaigns at market, Emirate, and store levels.
* Continuously analyze brand performance and recommend strategies to address challenges and seize opportunities.
* Conduct competitive analysis to guide marketing plans and maintain KFC’s competitive edge in the quick-service restaurant (QSR) industry.

**Channel Performance & Aggregator Growth**

* Develop and execute long-term and monthly visibility plans with aggregator platforms to drive sales growth.
* Monitor and analyze channel-level performance to identify opportunities for growth across delivery, dine-in, takeaway, drive-thru, and aggregator channels.
* Collaborate with aggregators to optimize visibility, promotions, and campaigns tailored to KFC’s target audience.
* Ensure alignment between marketing initiatives and aggregator-specific strategies to maximize return on investment (ROI).

**Operational Excellence**

* Work closely with cross-functional teams (such as Operations, Revenue Management, Supply Chain) to ensure alignment and successful execution of marketing plans.
* Manage the briefing, development, and implementation of advertising, promotions, media planning, POS materials, and packaging.
* Partner with agencies and suppliers to execute campaigns effectively, on time, and within budget.
* Launch campaigns, promotions, and projects within very tight timelines while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail in every execution, including pricing, offers, creative, legal copy, and aggregator content.
* Coordinate campaign readiness with Operations and Supply Chain before every launch (stock availability, store capacity, team briefing, and POS and aggregator set-up) to protect store operations and the guest experience.
* Monitor live campaigns and resolve issues quickly (e.g., pricing errors, stock-outs, or aggregator content gaps), then report results and lessons learned to improve future launches.
* Ensure all marketing materials and promotions comply with KFC brand standards and applicable advertising, media, and consumer protection regulations.

**Customer Experience**

* Ensure every KFC guest enjoys a memorable brand experience through value-driven and relevant marketing initiatives.
* Enhance consumer perception of KFC versus competitors through meaningful and innovative brand activities.
* Monitor guest feedback, ratings, and reviews across channels (including aggregators and social media) and use the insights to improve campaigns and the guest experience.

**Product & Innovation**

* Collaborate with the regional MENA team to adapt and localize product and innovation calendars for the regional market.
* Support the development and launch of new products and campaigns tailored to local customer needs and market trends.
* Monitor and analyze consumer insights to keep brand decisions aligned with customer preferences.

**Financial & Project Management**

* Support profitability for all products and campaigns, balancing brand objectives and customer satisfaction.
* Manage assigned budgets and project timelines to ensure cost efficiency and effectiveness.

**Digital, Data & AI Enablement**

* Build and maintain performance dashboards using analytics and BI tools (e.g., Power BI, Excel, Google Analytics) to track campaign, channel, and aggregator results and turn data into clear recommendations.
* Use AI tools to accelerate consumer insight analysis, competitor benchmarking, and the creation of campaign proposals, briefs, and presentations, with human review for accuracy and brand compliance.
* Prepare data-backed proposals and business cases for campaigns, promotions, and aggregator plans, including ROI forecasts and post-campaign evaluations.
* Apply digital and marketing technology (CRM, loyalty and digital ordering platforms, marketing automation, social listening, A/B testing) to personalize communications and improve conversion and retention.
* Use AI and customer data responsibly, in line with KFC policies and data protection requirements.

**Team Collaboration & Leadership**

* Engage with internal teams and stakeholders to foster creativity, innovation, and strategic alignment.
* Act as a brand champion, inspiring teams to uphold KFC’s values and objectives.

**Qualifications & Skills**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, or a related field.
* An MBA or master’s degree is a plus.

**Experience**

* 4–6 years of relevant marketing experience, preferably in the QSR, FMCG, or agency sector.
* Prior experience in campaign execution or brand management is highly preferred.
* Proven experience working with aggregator platforms and managing channel-specific growth strategies.
* Regional exposure or familiarity with the GCC, and wider MENA markets is an advantage.

**Skills**

* Fluency in English and spoken Arabic is required (Arabic speaking is a must).
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Effective communication, negotiation, and networking skills.
* Ability to analyze and optimize channel-level performance, including aggregators.
* Creative mindset with the ability to develop engaging social media content and campaigns.
* Excellent project management skills, including managing multiple deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Exceptional accuracy and attention to detail, with a proven ability to launch projects and campaigns within very tight timelines without compromising quality.
* Strong proposal-writing and presentation skills, including building persuasive, data-backed PowerPoint decks.
* Proficiency in digital marketing and CRM tools.
* Advanced data analysis skills (Excel and Power BI) with the ability to turn insights into actionable recommendations.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools for analysis, content, and proposal creation, with sound judgment on accuracy and data privacy.

· Track, analyze, and report the performance and effectiveness of PR and influencer campaigns, providing recommendations for improvement.

2. **Event Planning & Execution**

· Support reporting line and coordinate PR and influencer events across key Middle East markets, from planning to on-ground execution.

· Develop event concepts and activation ideas that generate earned media exposure, social buzz, and positive brand experiences.

· Coordinate with internal teams, agencies, media, KOLs, and external vendors to ensure smooth event execution.

· Manage venue sourcing, supplier coordination, production requirements, and event budgets.

· Oversee on-ground execution to ensure high-quality delivery and a consistent brand experience.

· Track event performance and provide post-event reports and recommendations.

3. **Budget Control & Vendor Management**

· Budgeting according to campaign needs, track spending and increase cost efficiency

· Source new vendors and manage contract related matters.

· Collaborate with vendors to assign briefs, supervise execution and ensure on time & in full delivery of agency services

· Ensure vendor/influencer/media fees are fair and within industry standard or campaign requirements

**4. Market Intelligence & Cross-functional Collaboration**

· Monitor regional media landscapes, competitor activities, and emerging market trends to identify opportunities for vivo.

1. Minimum of 3–4 years of relevant professional experience in Public Relations (PR) and influencer marketing, preferably with an established PR agency or international brand. Experience in the smartphone industry or a leading technology company will be an added advantage.​

2. Strong hands-on experience in PR and influencer marketing, with a proven track record of successfully managing media relations, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) collaborations, and PR campaigns.​

3. An established network of media contacts, journalists, influencers, and KOLs across the Middle East, particularly in the UAE and Saudi Arabia (KSA).​

4. Sound knowledge of the Middle East media landscape, influencer marketing ecosystem, regional market trends, and local consumer preferences.​

5. Proven ability to independently manage PR agencies, influencers, media partners, and external vendors while ensuring effective coordination and timely execution.​

6. Excellent communication, negotiation, interpersonal, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build and maintain strong professional relationships.​

7. A creative and innovative mindset, with the ability to develop compelling PR strategies, engaging campaign concepts, and effective influencer collaboration opportunities.​

8. Strong project management and multitasking abilities, with experience in handling multiple projects simultaneously while meeting strict deadlines.​

9. Experience in budget planning, allocation, monitoring, and management, along with the ability to prepare performance reports and evaluate campaign effectiveness.​

10. Experience in planning, organizing, coordinating, and executing PR events, media launches, and promotional activities will be an added advantage.​

11. Fluency in English is essential, with excellent written and verbal communication skills. Proficiency in Arabic will be considered a significant advantage.​

12. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with excellent attention to detail and the ability to evaluate PR performance and identify opportunities for improvement.​

13. A proactive, results-oriented, and ownership-driven approach, with the ability to take initiative, work independently, and remain accountable for assigned responsibilities.​

14. Excellent organizational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, coordinate multiple stakeholders, and manage several projects in parallel.​

15. Ability to work effectively under pressure, adapt to changing business priorities, and consistently deliver high-quality results within tight deadlines.

* Develop annual and mid-term product plans based on market trends, customer requirements and competitor activity.
* Define the right model, grade, specification, option and powertrain strategies for the UAE market.
* Prepare commercially sound product proposals and business cases for new models, facelifts, special editions and model-year changes.
* Recommend competitive product positioning and pricing based on customer value, market benchmarking and business objectives.
* Lead product readiness for new-model launches, including specifications, grades, pricing, system setup, homologation and sales readiness.
* Work closely with Marketing & Communications to develop compelling product stories, customer benefits and launch messaging.
* Manage assigned models throughout their lifecycle, monitoring sales, market share, stock, grade mix, customer demand and profitability.
* Identify opportunities for specification improvements, grade restructuring, pricing adjustments, accessory packages and tactical product actions.
* Translate product-performance data and market intelligence into actionable recommendations.
* Represent UAE market requirements and the Voice of the Customer when engaging with OEM and principal teams.
* Ensure vehicle specifications and product configurations comply with applicable regulatory requirements.
* Lead and develop the Product Manager reporting into the role.

**Required Skills To Be Successful**

* Strong automotive product, portfolio and lifecycle-management expertise.
* Excellent commercial judgment, business acumen and financial-analysis capabilities.
* Ability to interpret sales, market-share, stock, competitor and customer data and translate insights into business recommendations.
* Strong understanding of vehicle technology and technical specifications.
* Excellent project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple launches, priorities and deadlines.
* Strong stakeholder-management, communication, influencing and facilitation skills.
* Ability to build trusted relationships across Sales, Marketing, Demand & Supply, Aftersales, OEM and principal teams.
* Strong decision-making skills and the ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced environment.
* Genuine passion for automotive products, market trends and customer needs.

**About The Team**
You will join the Product Department within Al-Futtaim Automotive and work within a highly collaborative environment alongside Marketing & Communications, Sales, Demand & Supply, Aftersales, Homologation and OEM/principal teams.
  
  
This is a commercially influential position with a direct impact on product competitiveness, model profitability and the successful introduction of vehicles into the UAE market.
  
  
**What Equips You For The Role**

* University degree, preferably in Automotive Engineering or Mechanical Engineering.
* Minimum 8 years of experience within the automotive industry.
* At least 3 years of experience in an automotive product-related role.
* Previous OEM experience would be an advantage.
* Demonstrated experience in product planning, pricing, competitor benchmarking, new-model launches and lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to develop compelling business cases supported by market, commercial and financial data.
* Experience influencing senior stakeholders and coordinating complex cross-functional initiatives.

Al-Futtaim Automotive is one of the region's leading mobility businesses, operating across eight countries in the Middle East, Asia and North Africa.
  
  
With a portfolio of more than 25 world-leading brands, we deliver one of the region's most comprehensive mobility ecosystems.
  
  
Our capabilities span passenger vehicles, commercial vehicles and industrial equipment, backed by integrated logistics, leasing, aftersales and financial services that deliver a seamless customer experience across every stage of the mobility journey.
  
  
Our vision is to become a world-class mobility player, creating better experiences for our customers through innovation, digital transformation and a relentless focus on customer experience. We work alongside some of the world's most trusted automotive brands to shape the future of mobility, delivering solutions that meet the evolving needs of individuals, businesses and communities.
  
  
Behind everything we do is a team of more than 9,000 colleagues united by ambition, collaboration and a shared commitment to progress. Together, we're shaping the future of mobility, embracing new technologies and creating better experiences for our customers. At Al-Futtaim Automotive, you'll be empowered to turn ambition into action and help move our customers, our business and your career forward.

jobs.title: Head - Brand Operations

**Objective**
This position is responsible for leading the end-to-end operations of the brand across all retail touchpoints. The role ensures strategic alignment with business goals, drives revenue growth, operational efficiency, and brand excellence by managing sales, retail execution, team development, and customer satisfaction.
  
  
**Key Responsibility**
Sales and Profitability
  
  

* Achieve quantitative performance targets across key metrics such as Units Per Transaction (UPT), Average Transaction Value (ATV), monthly sales, sales per square foot, sales turnover, and shrinkage control.
* Define and drive store sales strategies to optimize profitability.
* Guide Area and Store Managers to enhance productivity and effective resource utilization.
* Control and reduce operational costs through process improvements and automation.
* Ensure compliance with SOPs, policies, and loss prevention guidelines across all stores.
* Supervise execution of brand-specific Visual Merchandising standards.
* Lead recruitment and training on sales techniques, customer service, and brand etiquette.
* Promote employee motivation and productivity through regular performance evaluation and coaching.

Employee Development
  
  

* Identify training and upskilling needs in collaboration with the L&D team.
* Formulate succession planning and talent development strategies.
* Set KPIs and KRAs for direct reports, conduct appraisals, and implement feedback mechanisms.
* Participate in recruitment and ensure behavioral and technical readiness of store teams.

Communication
  
  

* Conduct regular sales and operations reviews with Area and Store Managers.
* Communicate performance feedback and improvement areas to the store teams.
* Ensure brand engagement in customer loyalty programs such as Club Apparel.
* Participate in weekly management meetings to review business plans and results.

Stock Management
  
  

* Monitor and manage store inventory levels in collaboration with Brand and Planning teams.
* Drive coordination between operations, planning, and buying to improve product availability and inventory turnover.
* Identify and action on slow-moving stock; implement stock control and loss prevention initiatives.

Store Design and Projects Management
  
  

* Participate in the design and layout planning of new stores and refurbishments.
* Create store opening schedules in coordination with project and merchandising teams.
* Guide visual and operational readiness during store launches.
* Liaise with architects and project teams to ensure adherence to brand standards.

Miscellaneous
  
  

* Ensure brand visibility and alignment with marketing initiatives.
* Support with compliance, legal approvals, and documentation related to store operations.
* Provide insights to leadership on market trends, customer feedback, and performance risks.
* Training

**Desired Experience**

* 12-15 years of experience in brand operations, with a minimum of 5 years in a leadership role.
* In-depth understanding of operational KPIs, customer service, and brand execution in a multi-store environment.
* Strong commercial acumen and team leadership abilities.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Retail, or a related field; MBA is preferred.

jobs.title: Cluster Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
OUR PURPOSE AND CULTURE

At Rosewood Hotel Group, we are guided by our purpose of Enriching Lives and Creating Lasting Impressions. We believe that hospitality is about people and place, creating meaningful experiences for our guests, associates, partners and the communities we serve. With a culture built on relationship hospitality, we empower our associates to bring passion, creativity and a sense of purpose to everything they do.

THE TEAM

You will join the Sales and Marketing team supporting both Rosewood AMAALA and Rosewood Red Sea, two of the most anticipated luxury lifestyle destinations in the world. Reporting to the Cluster Director of Communications with a dotted-line relationship to the Cluster Director of Sales and Marketing, you will work closely with corporate teams, agency partners and operational leaders across both resorts. You will also lead and mentor two Content Creators, driving content excellence and digital storytelling across the cluster.

YOUR ROLE

As Cluster Marketing Manager, you will be responsible for shaping and elevating the marketing presence of Rosewood AMAALA and Rosewood Red Sea. Based at The Red Sea with regular travel to AMAALA, you will lead the strategy and execution of social media, content creation, influencer partnerships and brand expression across both resorts.

This is a highly visible and creative role requiring a strategic marketer who can balance brand storytelling with commercial performance. You will transform the unique cultural, wellness and regenerative narratives of each destination into compelling experiences that drive brand awareness, engagement, guest consideration and revenue. Working across multiple stakeholders, you will bring together creativity, analytics and leadership to ensure every touchpoint reflects Rosewood's philosophy of A Sense of Place.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE THE PLACE

Lead the social media strategy and editorial planning for both resorts, ensuring all content aligns with Rosewood's brand standards, seasonal priorities and destination storytelling.

Direct content production across photography, videography, short-form video, editorial content and social-first campaigns, providing creative leadership to Content Creators and agency partners.

Develop and manage influencer and creator partnerships, from identification and contracting through content planning, hosting experiences, performance evaluation and long-term relationship building.

Partner closely with Communications, Revenue, Reservations, Food and Beverage, Wellness, Retail, Operations and corporate teams to support launches, promotions, events and guest engagement initiatives.

Mentor and develop a high-performing content team while fostering collaboration across stakeholders, agencies, destination partners and leadership teams.

COULD THIS BE YOU?

You are a forward-thinking marketer who combines creative storytelling with strong expertise in brand strategy and commercial performance.

You are passionate about luxury hospitality, travel, wellness, lifestyle or destination marketing and know how to create aspirational content for discerning audiences.

You have successfully led social media, content creation, influencer collaborations and brand partnerships, delivering measurable business results.

You are confident managing content production processes, creative briefs, agency relationships and digital asset libraries while maintaining high quality standards.

You are comfortable navigating campaign reporting and performance dashboards, with the confidence to self-serve on day-to-day data needs.

You are an effective people leader who can coach, motivate and develop creative talent while managing multiple priorities across different resorts and stakeholder groups.

You communicate with confidence and professionalism, building strong relationships with senior leaders, corporate teams, partners, influencers and high-profile guests. Fluency in both English and Arabic will set you up for success in this role.

OUR BENEFITS

We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth and career development. As part of Rosewood Hotel Group, you will have the opportunity to build your career within a global luxury hospitality company while working alongside passionate professionals committed to excellence.

OUR COMMITMENT TO YOU

At Rosewood Hotel Group, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every associate feels valued, respected and empowered to succeed. We celebrate diversity and welcome individuals from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Through ongoing learning, development opportunities and a culture of collaboration, we support our associates in reaching their full potential while creating outstanding experiences for our guests.

**Leads the strategy, implementation and execution** of all marketing and promotional activities for the Gulf or Egypt portfolio of brands and therapy areas throughout the product(s) life cycle, ensuring launch success, growth, maximized portfolio value and the realization of revenue and profitability objectives, with the main objective of making the best strategies, tools, materials and communication channels available to all customer-facing colleagues. The CBL leads the cross-functional brand team and coaches Country Brand Managers (CBMs) to deliver the marketing goals across all sectors (private & public) and channels of distribution, in alignment with the company’s goals and strategies.

**CORE ACCOUNTABILITIES**

**1. BRAND STRATEGY & EXECUTION**

* Own portfolio strategy and lead the development of annual brand plans, the Local Brand Plan and the tactical matrix in collaboration with CBMs.

* Develop strategic marketing plans to accelerate launches, uptake and access to new and existing assets, and drive execution of key brand programs.
* Translate market trends, customer and patient insights, competitor activities, and performance data into portfolio priorities, opportunities and risks, including issues, MWMs and CSFs per brand or TA.
* Tailor global and regional strategies to local market needs and define local priorities for each brand.
* Define target customer segments and asset positioning, and lead promotional campaigns and customer engagement activities across all relevant channels and sectors.
* Own brand lifecycle management across the category portfolio, making trade-off decisions on which brands and products to prioritize to maximize growth and maintain competitiveness.
* Ensure timely, high-quality delivery of marketing programs and promotional materials, including adaptation of regional content, and oversee compliance reviews of materials and HCP engagements.

**2. BUSINESS & FINANCIAL PLANNING**

* Deliver sales, revenue, and profitability objectives for the portfolio, and meet or exceed local revenue and A&P objectives.
* Develop the country Op Plan, revenue targets, brand A&P and FTE allocations with the Category Lead.
* Own forecast accuracy: oversee sales forecasting, track brand performance against targets (LE exercises) and provide country input into overall Africa Middle East forecasts.
* Identify risks early and lead mitigation plans and corrective actions to achieve business goals.
* Accountable for planning, spending and controlling of the budgets agreed for the TA of responsibility, ensuring effective allocation of marketing resources across brands.
* Set ROI measures for marketing activities and optimize investment across the portfolio.
* Review pricing and recommend strategic pricing to leverage opportunities in all sectors, working closely with the Access lead.

**3. CROSS-FUNCTIONAL LEADERSHIP**

* Lead the cross-functional brand team across Sales/Field Force, Medical, Market Access, Regulatory, Legal, Health and Value, Supply Chain, BAI, PHE, Compliance and other key stakeholders.
* Align teams around portfolio priorities, business objectives, and execution plans, and partner with the Category Lead to ensure alignment with overall brand strategy and incorporation of market feedback.
* Partner with Sales/Field Force leadership to ensure effective implementation of campaigns and customer engagement activities, and train the Field Force on product positioning and prioritization.
* Secure product availability through collaboration with Supply Chain and demand planning teams.
* Coordinate with regional and global cross-functional teams to achieve brand objectives, and provide local insights and brand feedback to the Regional Therapeutic Area Lead (RTAL) / Brand Implementation Lead.

**4. EXTERNAL STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) and other senior external stakeholders in the private and public sectors, partnering with Medical to educate KOLs on emergent medical research and differentiated product attributes.
* Oversee agencies and vendors, including trans-creation agencies, to ensure high-quality execution of marketing initiatives within agreed budget, scope and timing.
* Identify market opportunities and customer needs, and design value-added customer programs with Medical and Field Force colleagues to ensure strong and consistent Pfizer engagement.

**5. SHARED BUSINESS RESPONSIBILITY**

* Shape country operating plans, forecasting, and long-term business planning with the Category Lead, Sales and Finance.
* Lead channel strategy development and customer journey optimization with channel marketing and Sales.
* Partner with Medical and Sales teams on KOL engagement and capability-building initiatives.
* Coach and develop CBMs, contribute to talent planning and team development, and support onboarding and development of sales team members to ensure strong brand knowledge and execution.

**DECISION RIGHTS**

* Own portfolio prioritization and make trade-off decisions across brands, therapy areas, investments, and initiatives to maximize portfolio performance and business impact.
* Set local brand strategies, customer segmentation, positioning, and tactical priorities by tailoring global and regional strategies to country market needs, and direct the Local Brand Plan and tactical matrix developed with CBMs.
* Approve allocation of marketing resources and A&P investments across the portfolio within agreed budgets to support revenue, launch, and growth objectives, and recommend strategic pricing actions in alignment with the Access lead.

The Digital Marketing Executive plays a key role in strengthening the hotel's digital presence, driving online visibility and supporting commercial performance across all digital channels. Acting as a Brand Champion, this role is responsible for supporting the planning, implementation, monitoring, and optimization of digital marketing initiatives, with a strong focus on driving direct bookings, enhancing digital conversion, and promoting the hotel's Rooms, F&B outlets, Spa and other revenue-generating experiences.
  
  
The Digital Marketing Executive will be responsible for maintaining and optimizing the hotel's digital platforms, ensuring that website content, offers, imagery, and information remain accurate, engaging, and aligned with brand standards. Working closely with the Commercial Director, Cluster Marketing Manager, Revenue Management, and internal stakeholders, this role will actively monitor digital performance, analyze key metrics, track campaign effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve online visibility, traffic and conversion.
  
  
The role will also support the execution and performance monitoring of paid digital campaigns, including search, display and social media advertising, while ensuring alignment with the hotel's overall marketing and commercial objectives. The Digital Marketing Executive will work collaboratively with the Cluster Marketing Manager to develop digital assets, support campaign launches, and ensure consistent brand communication across online channels.
  
  
This individual should demonstrate strong analytical skills, attention to detail, commercial awareness, and a proactive approach to identifying opportunities for digital growth. The ability to manage cluster priorities, interpret performance data and translate insights into actionable recommendations will be essential to the role.
  
  

* Maintain and regularly update the hotel's website and digital platforms, ensuring accurate information, promotions, imagery and brand consistency.
* Work closely with the Cluster Marketing Manager to support digital campaigns, website optimization and overall online performance.
* Monitor the hotel's presence across third-party platforms, including OTAs, ensuring content, imagery and promotional information remain accurate and up to date.
* Support the planning and execution of digital marketing campaigns to drive incremental Rooms and F&B ancillary revenue through paid search, social media advertising, and other online channels.

* Prepare monthly digital marketing performance reports, highlighting key results, trends, and opportunities for improvement.

* Conduct basic market analysis and competitor monitoring to track digital activity, seasonal offers, and emerging trends across the competitive set.
* Coordinate with Cluster Marketing Manager to ensure timely delivery of creative assets required for digital campaigns.
* Assist in planning and launching digital promotions, packages, and seasonal campaigns across relevant online platforms.
* Support the optimization of the hotel's online visibility, search engine presence, and direct booking opportunities.
* Complete relevant administrative tasks, including campaign documentation, invoices, budget tracking, and coordination with external digital partners.
* Stay informed about emerging digital marketing trends, platform updates, and opportunities to enhance the hotel's online presence.
* Support the Cluster Marketing Manager with digital marketing initiatives and other related tasks as required.

Education: Diploma required; additional education in sales and marketing fields preferred.
  
  
Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

##### **Job Purpose**

The Regional Brand and Marketing Manager is accountable for managing the execution of a high-impact brand and marketing strategy that drives customer growth and brand equity in alignment with market priorities. Leveraging the CCMB capabilities, the role demands tactical insight and detailed assessment of market dynamics, consumer insights, and competitive positioning to support the implementation of defined brand, commercial, and operational objectives, that are translated into focused, actionable briefs that enable CCMB specialist teams to create and execute effective campaigns, ensuring a seamless customer journey across paid, earned, shared, and owned channels.

The role ensures executional excellence and adherence to the standard operating procedures, enabling cross-functional teams to execute marketing initiatives with precision and efficiency.

**In this role you will:**

* Implement and adapt the Emirates brand strategy within assigned markets ensuring alignment with the CCMB measurement framework, business goals and and local market dynamics. Adapt regional brand positioning to meet local market needs while maintaining consistency and supporting regional opportunities.
* Leverage commercial data, market research, customer insights and analytics to understand the operating environment, business performance and market dynamics. Use these insights to guide tactical decision-making that supports brand performance and customer engagement across their journey contributing to measurable business impact.
* Act as the primary operational liaison between the regional commercial and country management teams and the CCMB specialist functions within assigned markets. Build collaborative relationships and maintain trusted advisor status through excellent account management and business understanding. Support strategic conversations led by the Manager Regional Brand & Marketing to prioritise long-term initiatives, align on brand objectives, and facilitate smooth campaign execution and cross-departmental collaboration to contribute to regional success.
* Deliver brand and marketing plans across the customer journey, ensuring initiatives align with regional brand positioning and are tailored to local market conditions and consumer behaviours. Ensure campaigns are well-briefed, executed within budget and meet delivery standards.
* Manage market level allocation of the regional marketing budget for assigned markets, tracking performance and monitoring spending to ensure financial efficiency and impact. Provide input on marketing return on investment (ROI) to support resource allocation and alignment with business outcomes.
* Identify and escalate risks that could affect brand and marketing execution, including legal, reputational, and operational concerns. Support the development of mitigation strategies to ensure seamless campaign delivery and protect Emirates' brand integrity.
* Stay up to date with trends across paid, earned, shared and owned channels monitoring emerging platforms and evolving marketing behaviours. Recommend adjustments to ensure the brand remains relevant, competitive, and strongly positioned.
* Support cross-functional teams and work closely with leadership to encourage a collaborative, motivated group of marketing professionals. Encourage a culture of innovation, continuous learning and delivery excellence that enables teams to execute brand strategies effectively and achieve business objectives.

##### **Qualification**

**To be successful in this role, you must meet the below requirements:**

* Degree or Honours (12+3 or equivalent) in Marketing or similar.
* 8+ years experience in Marketing & Media Communications, Brand/Product management or similar.
* Experience in leadership, market analysis and communication.
* Proven ability to develop and execute global marketing plans tailored to local markets.
* Demonstrated success in collaborating with cross-functional and cross-regional teams to drive alignment and results.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret marketing performance data and extract insights
* Solid track record of landing integrated, multi-channel marketing campaigns
* Experience adapting global brand messaging to regional audiences
* Effective leadership capabilities, including mentoring direct reports, and facilitating cross-functional collaboration.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
**About Sentient**
Sentient is building the future of open-source AI. Our mission is to ensure that the most powerful AI systems remain open, accessible, and beneficial to everyone.
  
  
Backed by leading investors including Founders Fund and Pantera Capital, Sentient brings together world-class AI researchers, engineers, and builders to develop cutting-edge open-source AI technologies.
  
  
Our work spans AI agents, model verification, AI benchmarking, and self-improving AI systems. We're focused on turning frontier research into useful, widely adopted products that push the boundaries of what's possible with open-source AI.
  
  
**About The Role**
We're looking for a highly technical, entrepreneurial Product Manager to help shape and build the next generation of AI products at Sentient.
  
  
You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge AI research and product development, identifying promising research breakthroughs and turning them into products that developers and businesses actually want to use.
  
  
This is a hands-on role that requires strong technical judgment, product intuition, and the ability to take ideas from early exploration through launch and adoption. We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable exploring new technologies, prototyping solutions, engaging with users, and working alongside researchers and engineers.
  
  
You'll collaborate closely with our research, engineering, and leadership teams to determine what we should build, why it matters, and how to bring it to market. The role reports to the VP of Product and works alongside the team’s PM Lead, who will set overall product direction.
  
  
**Location:**
Remote. The team is spread across Singapore, Hong Kong, and UAE, so you'll need regular overlap with Asia/Middle East working hours, with flexibility across timezones as we are a global team.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Find product opportunities where our research, emerging technology, and market need meet, then set the vision, priorities, and roadmap.
* Lead products from first concept through prototype, launch, and adoption, working with engineering, research, and go-to-market teams.
* Work with AI researchers to spot promising breakthroughs and turn them into product requirements, user experiences, and technical specifications.
* Evaluate technical approaches and make architectural trade-offs alongside engineering.
* Build prototypes and proofs of concept yourself, using code, APIs, and current AI tooling: LLMs, agents, evaluation frameworks, and developer infrastructure.
* Design experiments and evaluations to test product hypotheses, and move quickly from idea to working demo to user feedback.
* Talk directly with developers, design partners, and customers. Define and track adoption, engagement, performance, and retention, and feed what you learn back into product and research priorities.

****What We're Looking For****
**Required Qualifications**

* You have taken a technical product from concept to launch, and you can show us the product and its usage numbers.
* You have worked as a software or ML engineer, or have equivalent hands-on technical depth.
* You write Python well enough to build a working agent prototype against LLM APIs on your own.
* You have designed and run evaluations for an LLM or agent system, and can explain why a given eval does or does not predict real-world performance.
* You can point to a time you killed or reshaped a technically promising idea because users did not need it.
* You have driven an initiative from start to finish without a defined brief or someone else setting the scope.
* You can explain a research result to a customer and a customer problem to a researcher, clearly and in writing.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience as a founder, founding product manager, early-stage engineer, or technical product lead.
* Experience building AI developer tools, AI agents, ML infrastructure, model evaluation systems, or open-source products.
* Familiarity with agent frameworks and modern AI development workflows.
* Experience collaborating with research scientists or bringing emerging AI technologies to market.
* Contributions to open-source AI projects or active involvement in developer communities.
* Experience working with design partners to validate and refine new products.

****Why Join Sentient?****
**Why open source**
At a closed lab, the product is access to a model. Here, the product is something developers can run, inspect, and build on themselves. That changes the job in three ways.
  
  

* Your work is public. Most of what you ship lives in the open, where anyone can read it, fork it, and challenge it. Your track record is visible to the whole field, not locked inside one company.
* Your users are your collaborators. Developers file issues, send pull requests, and tell you what is broken within days. You learn faster than any private beta allows.
* You build for adoption, not lock-in. A product wins here because developers choose it, not because they have no alternative. That is a harder bar and a more honest one.

**What Else You Get**

* Work at the frontier of AI: Collaborate with leading researchers and engineers on technologies shaping the future of artificial intelligence.
* Meaningful ownership: Have a direct impact on product strategy, technical direction, and execution.
* Research meets real-world impact: Translate innovative AI research into practical products used by developers and organizations.
* Builder-driven culture: Work with an ambitious team that values experimentation, technical excellence, and delivering meaningful results.

If you're passionate about AI, enjoy building products from the ground up, and want to shape the future of open-source AI, we'd love to hear from you.

* ABOUT ASTRAZENECA

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company
  
  
focused on the discovery, development and commercialisation of prescription medicines
  
  
for some of the world’s most serious diseases.
  
  
Our ambition in Oncology is to redefine cancer care by following the science and putting
  
  
patients at the heart of everything we do. We aim to transform outcomes by bringing innovative
  
  
medicines to patients and working across the healthcare ecosystem to address barriers across the
  
  
cancer patient journey.
  
  

* ROLE SUMMARY

The Brand Manager, Oncology, Gulf is responsible for developing and executing brand strategy for assigned Oncology brands and indications across Gulf markets.
  
  
Working closely with the Oncology Franchise Lead, the Brand Manager will translate global and regional strategies into locally relevant plans that address market dynamics, customer needs
  
  
and opportunities across the patient journey.
  
  
The role will lead the brand-planning process, develop positioning and key strategic priorities, support launch and indication-expansion readiness, and drive high-quality execution across appropriate channels.
  
  
A critical part of the role is building a deep understanding of the Oncology ecosystem, including evolving treatment pathways, patient identification, diagnosis and testing, treatment initiation, referral patterns and barriers to optimal patient care. The Brand Manager will work cross functionally to identify opportunities where AstraZeneca can improve the customer and patient
  
  
experience while delivering sustainable brand growth.
  
  
The role requires close collaboration across Sales, Medical, Market Access, Diagnostics, Regulatory and other relevant cross-functional teams, while ensuring full compliance with AstraZeneca policies and local requirements.
  
  

* WHAT YOU’LL DO
* Brand strategy and business performance
* Lead the development and implementation of the strategic and operational brand plan for

assigned Oncology brand(s) and indications.
  
  

* Translate global and regional brand strategy into clear Gulf-market priorities, objectives,

tactics and KPIs.
  
  

* Develop robust brand positioning based on the evolving competitive landscape, customer

insights, clinical evidence and patient needs.
  
  

* Identify growth opportunities and barriers through analysis of brand performance, market

dynamics, treatment patterns and competitive developments.
  
  

* Lead forecasting and brand inputs into the business-planning process, working closely with

relevant commercial and finance stakeholders.
  
  

* Establish and monitor meaningful KPIs and brand dashboards, translating insights into

corrective actions when performance moves off plan.
  
  

* Manage the brand budget effectively and prioritise investment toward activities with the

greatest strategic impact.
  
  

* Launch and indication readiness
* Lead commercial preparation for new product launches and indication expansions, ensuring

clear milestones, accountabilities and readiness across the cross-functional team.
  
  

* Develop and execute pre-launch, launch and post-launch plans covering customer engagement,

field readiness, market-shaping activities and the appropriate channel mix.
  
  

* Anticipate potential barriers to adoption and work cross-functionally to develop appropriate

solutions ahead of launch.
  
  

* Patient journey and Oncology ecosystem
* Develop a deep understanding of the Oncology patient journey, identifying critical barriers

from disease awareness and diagnosis through testing, referral, treatment initiation and ongoing
  
  
patient management.
  
  

* Incorporate biomarker and diagnostic testing pathways, where relevant to the assigned

portfolio, into brand strategy and execution.
  
  

* Use patient, physician, account and market insights to identify opportunities to shorten delays

in diagnosis and treatment and improve eligible patient identification.
  
  

* Understand the roles and interdependencies of key stakeholders within the Oncology

ecosystem, including oncologists, pathologists, surgeons, radiologists, pharmacists, nurses,
  
  
laboratory stakeholders, payers and other relevant decision-makers.
  
  

* Customer engagement and omnichannel excellence
* Build a deep understanding of customer needs, behaviours and preferences and translate those

insights into meaningful customer experiences.
  
  

* Develop an effective omnichannel marketing mix, selecting the appropriate combination of

personal and digital channels for specific customer segments.
  
  

* Partner with field teams to translate brand strategy into clear, actionable customer engagement

priorities.
  
  

* Support promotional and scientific events from strategic concept through content development

and execution.
  
  

* Manage agencies effectively in developing high-quality campaigns, customer-facing materials,

digital initiatives and field-force promotional resources.
  
  

* External stakeholder engagement
* Contribute to the development and execution of stakeholder and Key External Expert (KEE)

engagement plans in partnership with Medical and other relevant functions.
  
  

* Build and maintain high-quality relationships with relevant external stakeholders in compliance

with local regulations and AstraZeneca policies.
  
  

* Generate actionable insights from customers and the wider Oncology ecosystem and ensure

these insights inform brand strategy and execution.
  
  

* Cross-functional leadership
* Act as a key member of the Oncology cross-functional team, creating alignment around the

brand strategy, priorities and execution plan.
  
  

* Collaborate effectively with Medical, Market Access, Sales, Diagnostics, Regulatory,

**Finance And Other Functions To Deliver Integrated Brand Objectives.**

* Demonstrate leadership through influence, bringing stakeholders together around clear

priorities even where there is no direct reporting relationship.
  
  

* Identify and share marketing best practices across Gulf markets and the wider AstraZeneca

organisation.
  
  

* Compliance and governance

**Position:** Brand Manager

The ideal candidate must have a strong background in fashion retail, with experience in brand development, marketing campaigns, merchandising coordination, and retail operations.

* Develop and implement brand strategies aligned with the company's business objectives.
* Maintain and strengthen brand identity, positioning, and market presence.
* Ensure consistency in brand communication, visual identity, and customer experience across all stores and digital platforms.
* Monitor fashion retail trends, competitors, and customer preferences.

* Coordinate with marketing, creative, and digital teams to develop engaging brand campaigns.
* Oversee social media campaigns, influencer collaborations, and digital marketing initiatives.

* Monitor competitor activities, pricing strategies, and promotional campaigns.

**6. Team & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with buying, merchandising, visual merchandising, e-commerce, and retail operations teams.
* Manage relationships with advertising agencies, suppliers, and external partners.
* Ensure timely execution of marketing initiatives and brand activities.

* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Fashion Management, or a related field.

* Proven experience managing fashion or lifestyle retail brands.
* Strong understanding of fashion trends, consumer behaviour, and retail marketing.
* Experience in planning and executing seasonal campaigns and product launches.
* Good understanding of visual merchandising and retail store operations.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret sales and marketing performance reports.
* Excellent communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.

**Key Competencies**

* Strategic brand planning
* Fashion retail market knowledge
* Marketing campaign execution
* Sales and business analysis
* Visual merchandising coordination
* Digital and social media marketing
* Budget management
* Leadership and communication

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Brand sales and revenue growth
* Brand awareness and market positioning
* Marketing campaign ROI
* Customer engagement and retention

* Seasonal campaign execution
* Market share and competitor performance

jobs.description:
Emerald Zebra, on behalf of our client, a global regulated trading and fintech group, is looking to hire a Group Product Manager to lead its Growth tribe. Dubai is preferred for its closeness to the Product and Engineering teams. Remote, or hybrid from the group's other offices, will be considered for a strong profile.

**The Role**

This is a product leadership role, not simply a more senior Product Manager title. You'll own the Growth tribe, covering Onboarding and Payments, line manage the Onboarding and Payments Product Managers and report directly to the VP of Product.

The product team has moved to a tribe model, and this role creates the leadership layer each tribe needs. You'll own the tribe's strategy, outcomes and the quality of its product management, staying close enough to the work to challenge discovery, prioritisation and decisions, and making client onboarding and payments smooth, secure and efficient.

**What You'll Do**

* Own the Growth tribe's strategy, priorities and key outcomes across Onboarding and Payments.
* Line manage the Onboarding and Payments Product Managers, set expectations, coach them and keep the standard of their work high.
* Turn the wider product strategy into a clear vision and plan for the tribe, and evolve it as evidence and priorities change.
* Make sure the team talks to customers, uses internal insight and product analytics, and grounds its recommendations in evidence.
* Build a culture of hypothesis-led development and proportionate experimentation before committing significant engineering time.
* Define success metrics before launch, then review and act on performance afterwards.
* Lead the payments domain, including deposit and withdrawal journeys, PSP performance, routing, cascading and risk constraints.
* Work with Engineering, Business Analysis, UX/UI, Data, Operations, Compliance and Commercial to take validated ideas through delivery.
* Bring urgency and accountability: spot flat metrics or weak execution early, step in and keep senior stakeholders informed.

**Qualifications and Experience**

* A B2C product background. Candidates with a B2B product background will not be considered.
* Product leadership experience as a Group or Lead Product Manager, or as a Senior Product Manager already leading people and owning a wider product area.
* Genuine line management of Product Managers. This is not an individual contributor role.
* Payments experience is required: deposits and withdrawals, payment journeys, PSPs and gateways, routing, cascading, payment success and risk constraints.
* Strong onboarding, activation, conversion or other growth funnel experience.
* Specific examples of customer discovery, analytics, experimentation and measurable outcomes.
* The confidence to defend a product view with evidence in front of senior stakeholders.
* Retail FX or CFD trading experience is an asset but not essential. Strong backgrounds in fintech, payments, digital banking, wallets, crypto or iGaming are relevant.

**The Type of Person We're Looking For**

* A charismatic leader with strong stakeholder management skills.
* A strategic thinker who is still hands-on.
* High ownership and pace, stepping in when work is drifting or metrics are flat.
* Develops people and raises the standard of the Product Managers around them.

**Package and Benefits**

* Salary: EUR 6,000 to 8,000 gross per month
* Annual performance bonus
* Monthly cash flex benefit (taxable)
* Hybrid working for office-based hires: 3 days in the office and 2 days from home
* 30 days per year remote working policy
* 40 days annual leave including public holidays
* Private medical insurance, 100% covered for the employee and 50% for dependents
* Work permit support and costs covered for candidates based in Cyprus who need one

Apply at the link or send your CV to tanya.malinouskaya@emeraldzebra.cy. All applications are handled in confidence by Emerald Zebra Specialist Recruitment and Executive Search, Cyprus.

All trading services are provided by STARTRADER entities regulated in other jurisdictions*
**Role Overview**
The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing the marketing strategy for Startrader across brand, content, social media, email marketing, events and demand generation. The role builds Startrader's market presence among institutional clients and generates qualified pipeline for the sales team. Positioned within the Global Marketing team, the role works closely with group marketing functions to apply shared resources and brand standards, while aligning marketing priorities with Startrader's commercial objectives through a reporting line to the Head of Marketing.

jobs.title: Product Manager – UC
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
**About us**

NMK Electronics, a Midwich Group company, stands at the forefront of the professional AV industry in the Middle East.  With a strong presence across the region, NMK combines a premium portfolio of reputable brands, a dedicated and skilled team and a reputation built on trust and results that started in the 1980s.  
  
Our expertise has earned us the confidence of top consultants, system integrators and end users. NMK has delivered a number of prominent local AV projects throughout the region, and with a mission to drive growth, this is an exciting time to join the team.
  
  
**About the Role**
The Product Manager will be responsible for managing our Unified Communications (UC) product portfolio and vendors.  You will be the first point of contact for the vendor and have joint success plans while reporting to the business unit manager. You will take ownership of the assigned brands, including business development, pipeline management, vendor engagement, and achievement of agreed targets.
  
The ideal candidate should be an experienced professional, with a proven background in AV and UC products.  You will have a strong background in vendor management, stock and sales engagement.  Forecasting and performance tracking is essential for this role. 
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Understand your vendor objectives and drivers to feed into relevant sales and marketing activity
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with vendors and their sales teams and communicate with them regularly
* Ensure customer data is accurately maintained and regularly updated within the CRM/ERP systems
* Collaborate with the marketing team to build and showcase a robust client reference portfolio
* Plan monthly stock orders based on sales forecasts
* Track inventory levels, manage aging stock, and free up inactive stock.
* Negotiate pricing, secure projects, and ensure price protection where needed
* Coordinate closely with technical support and application teams to ensure effective client service and timely resolution of technical queries
* Enable the Sales and Technical teams with the required UC product knowledge and support, and work closely with them to identify, develop, and drive opportunities
* Prepare and present a comprehensive quarterly business plan outlining sales targets, key accounts, and strategic initiatives for the upcoming fiscal year
* Support the line manager in identifying and onboarding new sales partners and representatives across the Middle East
* Maintain strong market engagement across key accounts, inside-sales accounts, system integrators, and channel partners, and build and maintain a strong network within the UC channel
* Conduct commercial negotiations to secure orders under favorable financial and contractual terms
* Actively participate in sales initiatives, including client visits, calls, trade exhibitions, product demonstrations, and customer seminars.
* Plan and execute UC partner enablement sessions, product trainings, webinars, customer events, and demand-generation activities.
* Maintain knowledge of all product and service offerings of the company
* Maintain an awareness of market trends and competitor activity

**Job Requirements**

* A minimum of 4–5 years of proven experience in business development within the AV industry, including experience with UC products
* Strong technical competency in UC products, supported by certifications on major UC platforms such as Microsoft Teams.
* Familiarity with CRM and ERP systems.
* Strong sales acumen with a demonstrated history of achieving or exceeding targets
* Outstanding communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills
* Strong presentation skills, with confidence in delivering tailored solutions to diverse audiences
* Highly focused and self-motivated
* Exceptional verbal and written English communication
* A valid local driving license is required for this role
